dcfb2cc0.title: Cloud Architect
dcfb2cc0.description:
Overview of 66degrees
  
  
66degrees is an end-to-end AI transformation partner that guides enterprises from complex business challenges to clear, quantifiable outcomes. Our company is the culmination of several successful firms, each a leader in its own right in cloud, artificial intelligence, and data. This convergence of talent and expertise is how we help businesses reach their own "inflection point," where chaotic data becomes a strategic asset, complexity becomes clarity, and AI becomes an engine for growth. Our ultimate vision is to be the catalyst for a future where every business operates as an intelligent enterprise, with autonomous systems unlocking human potential.
  
  
At 66degrees, we believe in thriving through challenges and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way.
  
  
**Overview Of 66degrees**
66degrees is a leading consulting and professional services company specializing in developing AI-focused, data-led solutions leveraging the latest advancements in cloud technology. With our unmatched engineering capabilities and vast industry experience, we help the world's leading brands transform their business challenges into opportunities and shape the future of work.
  
  
At 66degrees, we believe in embracing the challenge and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way.
  
  
**Overview Of Role**
66degrees is looking for creative, dedicated, and personable technology business professionals for a Cloud Architect position. We are looking for someone with a broad range of technical and consulting skills and aptitude. Our ideal candidate will display relentless curiosity and drive around how we organize ourselves and deploy/use technology to ensure our clients GCP environments are reliable and secure. We are looking for the right fit with our growing organization and we will invest in training.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Build a trusted advisory relationship with strategic accounts and engage with management.
* Identify customer priorities, technical objections, and design strategies encompassing the Google ecosystem to deliver business growth and resolve blockers.
* Lead requirements gathering and project scoping.
* Solution design, problem-solving, and architecture diagramming.
* Provide domain expertise around public cloud and enterprise technology, and effectively promote Google Cloud with clients, at conferences, and online.
* Provide recommendations on integration strategies, enterprise architectures, platforms, and application infrastructure needed to implement a complete solution for clients.
* Lead planning, status, and standup meetings.
* Travel to customer sites, conferences, and other related events as required.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of GCP experience is a must. Experience in other clouds is beneficial.
* GCP Architect Certification required, other certifications for Google, Kubernetes, or Terraform a plus.
* Must have played 2+ years as a GCP Architect.
* Experience in building, architecting, designing, and implementing distributed global cloud-based systems.
* Extensive experience with security (zero trust) and networking in cloud environments
* Capable of advising and implementing CI/CD practices to clients using tools such as GitHub, GitLab, Cloud Build, and Cloud Deploy and concepts such as GitOps and GitFlow.
* Experience in containerising workloads using Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and Artifact Registry.
* Experience with structured Cloud Architecture practices, hybrid cloud deployments, and on-premises-to-cloud migration deployments and roadmaps.
* Knowledge of technology solutions and ability to learn emerging technologies, methodologies, and solutions in the Cloud/IT technology space.
* Ability to work cross-functionally, engage and influence audiences.
* Excellent organisational skills and customer-facing communication.
* Proficiency in documentation and knowledge transfer using remote meetings, written documents, and technical diagrams slide decks.
* Experience in implementing hybrid connectivity using VPN or Cloud Interconnect is a plus.

*66degrees is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, national origin, age, weight, height, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status or other legally protected class.*
***Please note, we cannot sponsor or transfer any visas, of any kind, at this time.***
*66degrees is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, national origin, age, weight, height, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status or other legally protected class.*
**AI Transparency & Disclosure**
As an AI transformation partner, 66degrees leverages intelligent solutions to enhance our recruitment experience. We utilize AI tools—including LinkedIn Recruiter’s Hiring Assistant and interview transcription technologies—to assist with sourcing, role analysis, and capturing interview highlights.
  
  
These tools augment our process, but we "Commit to Our Craft" by ensuring all final hiring decisions are made by our human Talent Team. By applying, you acknowledge the use of these technologies to help us "Win Together" in finding the best fit for our team.

3814f00b.title: Solution Architect Specialist
3814f00b.description:
**What you will be doing (Role Accountabilities)**

• Lead the end-to-end design of messaging solutions using Java, WebLogic, Spring Boot, Microsoft Graph mail API, React or Angular, AWS, and SQL and NoSQL databases.

• Apply Clean Architecture and microservices principles to create modular, testable and maintainable solutions with high availability and low latency.

• Design scalable and cost-effective cloud architectures using AWS services.

• Provide technical leadership and mentor development teams on solution implementation, engineering standards and adoption of new technologies.

• Collaborate with product managers, business analysts and delivery teams to define requirements and align technical solutions with business goals.

• Architect SQL and NoSQL data solutions that support efficient processing, data integrity and security.

• Create and maintain architecture documentation, roadmaps and technical specifications for stakeholders and engineering teams.

• Assess industry developments in architecture, cloud and messaging technologies, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

• Design messaging solutions for high availability, disaster recovery, fault tolerance, security, scalability and performance.

**What you’ll need to succeed (Skills & Experience)**

**Essential**

• 10 to 12 years of professional experience in software development and solution architecture, including customer messaging systems.

• Strong experience with Java, WebLogic, Spring Boot, and web technologies such as React or Angular.

• Expertise in designing AWS cloud solutions, with hands-on experience of services such as EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS and API Gateway.

• Experience designing SQL and NoSQL data solutions using technologies such as MySQL, MongoDB or DynamoDB.

• Strong understanding of Clean Architecture, microservices architecture and system design patterns.

• Experience leading and mentoring development teams while promoting engineering standards and high-quality delivery.

• Strong problem-solving and communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to stakeholders.

**Desirable**

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.

• AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional or TOGAF certification.

• Experience working in Agile or Scrum environments and participating in Agile ceremonies.

• Familiarity with CI/CD and DevOps practices and tools such as Jenkins, GitLab or AWS CodePipeline.

• Knowledge of messaging technologies and integration patterns, including IBM MQ, RabbitMQ, Kafka or WebLogic JMS.

• Experience designing high-throughput messaging systems for high availability, disaster recovery and fault tolerance.

b2b9c20d.description:
**Principal AI Solutions Architect – Enterprise AI & Agentic Platforms**

**Location**

**Chennai, India**

**Experience**

**8–18+ Years**

We are seeking an exceptional Principal AI Solutions Architect to lead the design, implementation, and scaling of enterprise-grade AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Intelligent Automation platforms that will drive the future of our engineering and product ecosystem.

**Role Overview**

This is a hands-on architecture and leadership role responsible for defining and executing Solartis’ enterprise AI strategy.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in LLMs, SLMs, RAG architectures, AI Agents, Agentic AI systems, AI orchestration frameworks, enterprise AI governance, and production-scale AI platform development.

This role requires a rare combination of architecture leadership, hands-on engineering expertise, business understanding, and AI innovation capabilities.

The individual will work closely with Engineering, Product, Operations, Architecture, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership teams to transform traditional enterprise platforms into AI-powered intelligent systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

Enterprise AI Strategy & Architecture

 Define and drive the enterprise AI architecture roadmap.

 Develop AI transformation strategies aligned with business objectives.

 Establish AI reference architectures, standards, governance models, and best practices.

 Drive adoption of AI-first design principles across products and engineering teams.

 Architect knowledge repositories, vector databases, semantic search systems, and enterprise knowledge assistants.

 Optimize retrieval quality, grounding accuracy, hallucination prevention, and response relevance.

 Build scalable knowledge management ecosystems leveraging structured and unstructured data.

 Build intelligent workflows capable of planning, reasoning, orchestration, execution, and decision support.

 Implement Agentic AI frameworks for software development, testing, support, customer operations, underwriting, claims processing, and business workflows.

 Establish agent governance, monitoring, security, and observability practices.

Large Language Models & Small Language Models

 Evaluate, benchmark, and optimize LLMs and SLMs across business use cases.

 Design hybrid AI architectures combining proprietary, open-source, and commercial models.

 Implement model selection, routing, orchestration, fine-tuning, and optimization strategies.

 Lead model performance, cost optimization, and inference efficiency initiatives.

AI Engineering & Platform Development

 Build scalable AI platforms supporting enterprise-wide adoption.

 Develop reusable AI services, frameworks, accelerators, SDKs, and APIs.

 Establish AI MLOps, LLMOps, and AgentOps practices.

 Design AI observability, monitoring, evaluation, and governance capabilities.

 Provide thought leadership to executive management and engineering teams.

311ed48f.title: Urgent Hiring For Solution Architect/Technical Architect
311ed48f.description:
**Role**: Full Stack Technical Architect / Solution Architect

**Experience**: 12-15 years | Software Development | Mediclaim TPA

  

**Job Summary**

  

We are seeking a hands-on Technical Architect to lead the architecture, design, and technical development of enterprise web applications for Mediclaim and Health Insurance operations. The role will drive scalable, secure, and high-performance solutions across customer portals, pre-enrollment platforms, and internal business applications.

The position combines technical architecture with active development, engineering standards, and leadership of the web development team, including mentoring developers and leveraging AI-assisted development to improve productivity and software quality.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* **Solution Architecture**: Define application architecture, technology choices, design patterns, integration strategies, and high- and low-level technical designs.
* **Hands-on Development**: Contribute to complex coding, API development, database design, performance optimization, debugging, and migration of legacy ASP.NET/.NET Framework applications with newer .NET / Java based technologies.
* **Full Stack Architecture**: Architect solutions using .NET Core, MVC, ASP.NET, .NET Framework, React JS, and Microsoft SQL Server.
* **API & System Integration**: Define REST API standards, authentication and authorization mechanisms, SSO integrations, and connectivity with insurers, hospitals, corporate clients, and third-party systems.
* **Database Architecture**: Design data models, database schemas, stored procedures, indexing strategies, transaction management, and query optimization approaches.
* **Security & Performance**: Establish secure coding practices, address VAPT findings, protect sensitive health and personal data, and optimize application performance and scalability.
* **AI-Assisted Development**: Use AI coding assistants for code generation, refactoring, testing, debugging, and documentation, ensuring appropriate validation of generated code.
* **Technical Leadership**: Guide the Web Development team, conduct architecture and peer code reviews, resolve complex technical issues, and mentor developers on coding standards and best practices.
* **CI/CD & Engineering Excellence**: Drive Git-based development workflows, GitLab CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and reliable deployment practices.
* **Technical Governance**: Evaluate technical risks and implementation approaches, support production issue resolution, and maintain architecture diagrams, technical specifications, and development standards

  

**Required Technical Skills**

  

* 12-15 years of software development experience, including substantial experience in technical architecture and full-stack application development.
* Strong expertise in C#, .NET Core / modern .NET, ASP.NET MVC/Web API, and .NET Framework 4.5. and hands on experience with React JS, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
* Advanced Microsoft SQL Server skills, including data modeling, stored procedures, indexing, execution plans, and query optimization.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs layered architecture, enterprise integration patterns, and microservices where appropriate.
* Advanced Microsoft SQL Server skills, including data modeling, stored procedures, indexing, execution plans, and query optimization.
* Experience with SSO, authentication and authorization, secure coding, VAPT remediation, logging, monitoring, and error handling.
* Practical experience with GitLab, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, peer reviews, and application deployment.
* Experience using AI coding assistants to improve development productivity while maintaining code quality, security, and reliability.
* Strong technical decision-making, problem-solving, communication, team mentoring skills
* Working knowledge of Java and PostgreSQL is desirable.

  

**Preferred Domain Knowledge**

  

* Experience in Mediclaim, health insurance, TPA, or healthcare applications.
* Familiarity with cashless pre-authorization, reimbursement claims, member enrollment, policy data, hospital networks, and insurer/corporate integrations.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms, containerization, distributed systems, health data privacy, and audit requirements.

  

**Qualifications & Expected Outcomes**

  

* Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline preferred.
* 12–15 years of overall experience in software development, architecture, and enterprise application delivery.
* Demonstrated experience in technical architecture, solution design, and leading full-stack development teams.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and technical decision-making skills.
* Delivery of secure, scalable, maintainable application architectures aligned with business requirements.
* Improved engineering productivity through AI-assisted development, automation, and consistent technical standards.
* Strong technical guidance, improved developer capabilities, and reliable delivery of enterprise applications

6526a7a2.title: Cloud Security Engineer/Architect
6526a7a2.description:
**Context** Cloud-Native Infrastructure Security, Compliance & Enforcement (Azure Services)

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Cloud professional with strong expertise in Azure infrastructure security, security assurance, and cloud architecture. The role will focus on assessing Azure services, defining and implementing security controls, and identifying security risks, misconfigurations, and control gaps across enterprise Azure environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Evaluate new and existing Azure services from a security, governance and risk perspective.
* Define, review, and recommend security policies, standards, and controls for Azure infrastructure and services.
* Review existing Azure security policies and controls and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Assess whether existing policies and controls adequately address emerging Azure services, technologies, and security risks.
* Translate security requirements and identified risks into practical and implementable Azure controls.
* Continuously enhance cloud security policies and controls based on evolving Azure capabilities, threats, and organizational requirements.
* Identify potential security risks, misconfigurations, and gaps associated with Azure infrastructure and services.
* Provide actionable recommendations to strengthen the overall security posture of Azure environments.
* Apply the **Microsoft Cloud Security Benchmark (MCSB)** to assess and improve Azure security posture.
* Use **attack path analysis** to identify potential attack routes and security weaknesses within Azure environments.

**Required Skills & Experience:**

* Strong understanding of Microsoft Azure infrastructure and core services.
* Strong knowledge of Azure **networking, compute, storage, identity, access management, and resource management**.
* Experience developing, reviewing, or assessing cloud security policies, standards, and controls.
* Ability to translate technical security risks and requirements into practical security controls.
* Experience assessing Azure infrastructure and services from a security perspective.
* Good understanding of the **Microsoft Cloud Security Benchmark (MCSB)** and its application to Azure environments.
* Understanding of **attack path analysis** and its use in identifying potential security risks and attack routes.
* Knowledge of **Azure Policy, governance, and security best practices**.
* Basic knowledge of **Microsoft Defender for Cloud**.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and risk-assessment skills.

6644d2c7.title: Architect
6644d2c7.description:
**Company:** NoBroker Interiors  
**Location:** Pune, Maharashtra  
**Experience:** 0-1 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Education:** B.Arch / B.Des (Interior Design) / Diploma in Interior Design

  

**About NoBroker**

NoBroker is a technology-driven real estate platform that simplifies property-related services. NoBroker Interiors offers interior design solutions to homeowners, helping them transform their spaces through functional planning and thoughtfully designed interiors.

  

**Job Summary**

We are looking for creative, enthusiastic, and detail-oriented freshers to join our NoBroker Interiors team in Pune. The candidate will work on residential interior design projects, assisting with space planning, 2D layouts, 3D visualizations, material selection, and design coordination.

This role is ideal for fresh graduates who are passionate about interior design and want to build their careers in the residential interiors industry.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist in designing residential interiors, including living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, and wardrobes.
* Prepare 2D floor plans, furniture layouts, and interior design drawings.
* Create 3D designs and visualizations based on client requirements.
* Understand client preferences, functional needs, and design expectations.
* Assist in selecting materials, finishes, colors, furniture, and accessories.
* Coordinate with design, sales, project execution, and other internal teams.
* Support site visits, measurements, and verification of site dimensions as required.
* Incorporate client feedback and make design revisions.
* Ensure designs meet functional requirements, space optimization goals, and project specifications.

  

**Required Skills**

* Degree or diploma in Architecture, Interior Design, or a related field.
* Freshers and recent graduates are welcome to apply.
* Basic understanding of residential interior design and space planning.
* Working knowledge of AutoCAD is preferred.
* Familiarity with SketchUp, 3ds Max, V-Ray, Enscape, or similar visualization tools is an advantage.
* Understanding of furniture layouts, materials, finishes, and interior design concepts.
* Good communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Creativity, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.

  

**Candidate Profile**

* Passionate about interior design and residential spaces.
* Able to understand design briefs and translate them into practical layouts.
* Comfortable working in a collaborative, target-driven environment.
* Willing to learn and adapt to project requirements.
* Portfolio or academic interior design projects are an advantage.

  

**Why Join NoBroker Interiors?**

* Opportunity to work on real residential interior design projects.
* Hands-on exposure to design planning and customer requirements.
* Learn from experienced professionals in the interiors industry.
* Build practical skills in a fast-paced, technology-driven organization.

  

**Interested candidates can apply with their updated resume and design portfolio, if available.**

c74f65e4.title: SAP CPI Consultant (Cloud integration)
c74f65e4.description:
Role & Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, configure, and support integration solutions using SAP CPI / SAP Cloud Integration.
* Design and implement Application-to-Application (A2A) and Business-to-Business (B2B) integration scenarios.
* Develop, configure, deploy, and maintain CPI iFlows.
* Develop custom integration logic using Groovy scripting and build message mappings and data transformations.
* Configure and work with OData, SOAP, RFC, File, HTTP/HTTPS, and other relevant adapters.
* Develop and support OData services and backend service provisioning.
* Work with ABAP backend systems for integration requirements.
* Design and implement SAP and non-SAP system integrations, including ALE/IDoc scenarios.
* Work extensively with SAP Process Orchestration (SAP PO), including ESR, Integration Directory, AAE/AEX, and Integration Engine.
* Configure and maintain SAP System Landscape Directory (SLD).
* Perform end-to-end integration testing, validation, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Perform root-cause analysis and implement technical fixes for interface and integration failures.
* Support deployments, production releases, and post-go-live activities.
* Prepare technical specifications, interface documentation, and deployment documentation.
* Collaborate with SAP functional consultants, ABAP developers, architects, and business teams.

**Skills & Qualifications**
Must-Have
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience with SAP CPI / SAP Cloud Integration and CPI-PI environments.
* Strong experience implementing A2A and B2B integrations.
* Hands-on CPI iFlow development and Groovy scripting experience.
* Strong understanding of message mapping and data transformation.
* Hands-on experience with OData, SOAP, RFC, and File adapters.
* Strong knowledge of SAP PO, including ESR, Integration Directory, AAE/AEX, and Integration Engine.
* Strong experience with ALE and IDoc integrations.
* Any Graduate; relevant SAP integration expertise and hands-on delivery experience are the primary evaluation criteria.
* 8+ years of overall SAP/integration experience.
* Immediate joiners will be prioritized.

**Preferred**

* Good to have: SAP API Management, SAP Integration Advisor, SAP Enterprise Messaging, and SAP Open Connectors.
* Good to have: SAP Workflow and BRF+, SAP BPM / BRM, SAP Cloud Workflow, and Cloud Business Rules.
* Good to have: SAP Cloud Platform – Neo and SAP BTP – Cloud Foundry.

Benefits & Culture Highlights
  
  

* Competitive Compensation aligned with industry standards.
* Flexible Work Environment (Remote-first culture).
* Health & Wellness Benefits.
* Learning & Certification Support.
* Career Growth in a high-performance environment.
* Exposure to global projects and enterprise clients.
* Employee Engagement & Recognition Programs.

b03c6415.title: Director, Technical Consulting (Salesforce Principal Architect)
b03c6415.description:
**Description**
Salesforce Professional Services - Global Delivery Centre (GDC) focuses on delivering strategic engagements that define transformational opportunities and execution of change programs. We are the trusted delivery partner for Salesforce Professional Services that ensures end to end multi-cloud delivery capabilities across all Salesforce technologies and scales with agility for successful customer outcomes! We at GDC strive to foster growth & innovation and enable for Salesforce Professional Services with focus on performance, productivity & impact.
  
  
**Role Overview**
Salesforce is currently seeking a Director, Technical Consulting (in the Architects’ Practice) to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. We are looking for an experienced professional services leader who has experience in scaling professional services delivery centers across the world. The Director, Technical Consulting role plays a meaningful part in enabling, deploying, and building the careers of our technical architects team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* You’ll be responsible for planning capacity, hiring, training, and mentoring our Technical Architects, as well as guide them on their CTA journey and their upskilling path across modern AI platforms.

30d0b386.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Fulfillment By Amazon (FBA)
30d0b386.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Ready to do something big?  
  
How would you build the next generation of mission-critical systems and services that power the ability to send, store, and manage billions of products across the globe on behalf of our selling partners?  
  
Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is the Amazon service for worldwide sellers that offers access to Amazon's vast distribution network as a service. Similar to how AWS provides infrastructure as a service, FBA allows sellers to only pay for what they use, leveraging our world-class infrastructure. Sellers in 135 countries worldwide, from Fortune 50 companies to hundreds of thousands of small businesses and entrepreneurs, rely upon our technology to grow and thrive on Amazon's Marketplaces.  
  
In a very real way, we are changing lives with the work we do. FBA team members wake up every day thinking about how to enable our sellers to be successful by building highly scalable and highly reliable platforms. Enabling seller success allows us to provide Amazon customers with unparalleled selection and pricing. FBA is a win for sellers and a win for customers.  
  
What is Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA)?  
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IAi4fPb\_kp4&t=2s  
  
The Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) team  
https://vimeo.com/80948105  
  
Third-party sellers have become one of Amazon's greatest growth engines, outpacing our own first-party retail business for years. That success did not happen by accident. We invested in building the best possible selling tools — from inventory management and payment processing to shipment tracking, reporting, and cross-border commerce — and we continue to invent new ones every year. FBA and the Prime membership program sit at the heart of that effort, dramatically improving the customer experience of buying from independent sellers and unlocking growth for businesses of every size.  
  
As a Principal Technical Program Manager with FBA, you will lead broad cross-organization efforts from the early stages through release. You will work closely with product managers, engineering managers, scientists, and engineers to build the next generation of seller platforms. You will be responsible for influencing the organization's product and technical roadmap and technical architecture. You will drive organization-wide engineering and operational excellence initiatives, represent difficult trade-off decisions and solutions clearly to senior leaders, and leverage your technical knowledge to guide technical choices. You will manage cross-functional and cross-organization communication to ensure all stakeholders are informed and needs are aligned, guiding technical direction to deliver solutions that meet Amazon's high standards for customer satisfaction, efficiency, stability, extensibility, simplicity, and operational excellence.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Lead broad, cross-organizational programs from strategy definition through delivery, owning the technology roadmap for seller-facing platforms and driving alignment across product, engineering, and science teams.
* Define and decompose complex technical problems into clear solutions, assessing risk, driving clarity, and creating the right sense of urgency to keep programs on track.
* Influence the organization's product and technical architecture by applying deep system knowledge, identifying gaps across services and workflows, and proposing improvements that reduce repeated effort year over year.
* Partner with senior leadership to communicate trade-offs, present options, and drive decisions — managing cross-functional stakeholder alignment and escalating with strong judgment when necessary.
* Amplify your impact by mentoring other technical program managers, driving adoption of program management best practices, and contributing to the broader technical community.

  
A day in the life  
Your primary focus will be guiding large-scale, cross-team programs that directly shape how millions of sellers interact with Amazon's fulfillment network. You will spend your time working across product managers, engineering leaders, and scientists — aligning priorities, unblocking technical decisions, and ensuring delivery stays on course. Expect a mix of deep technical design reviews, strategic roadmap discussions with senior leaders, and hands-on problem solving when programs hit ambiguity.  
  
About the team  
The FBA team builds and operates the platforms that enable sellers in 135 countries to store, ship, and manage billions of products through Amazon's global fulfillment network. Our mission is straightforward: make sellers successful so customers get the selection and value they expect. We are investing in the next generation of seller tools and infrastructure, and this role will be central to shaping that future. If you want to work on programs that operate at massive scale and have a direct impact on both sellers and customers worldwide, this is the team for you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 5+ years of software development experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience managing technical programs across cross-functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

37122c51.title: Presales Consultant
37122c51.description:
**Company Description**

  

Truva is a prop-tech ,real estate startup founded by IIT and Stanford alumni to make buying and selling homes in India simple, transparent, and enjoyable. The company specializes in fully renovated, quality-checked, and legally assured homes for buyers, and offers sellers a streamlined process with upfront tokens and guaranteed pricing. Truva manages the end-to-end transaction, including data-backed pricing, professional renovations, legal paperwork, and one-year quality guarantees. Currently operating in Mumbai, Truva has helped over 100 families buy and sell homes worth more than 160 crores since its launch in January 2024. The team is focused on building the future of real estate transactions through technology, operational excellence, and customer-centric services.

  

**Role Description**

  

The Presales Consultant role at Truva is a full-time/ contractual, on-site position based in Mumbai. In this role, you will be closely working with the sales team to understand client requirements, analyze property and market data, and craft tailored solutions that highlight Truvas offerings. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting discovery calls, preparing presentations, demos, and proposals, and supporting client meetings with clear explanations of Truvas processes, guarantees, and value proposition. The consultant collaborates with operations and project teams to ensure feasibility and alignment of proposed solutions, and maintains accurate documentation of presales activities in internal systems. This role also involves contributing to continuous improvement of presales playbooks, gathering feedback from prospects, and supporting training for new team members on Truvas products and services.

  

**Qualifications**

* Strong Analytical Skills to interpret market data, property metrics, and client requirements.
* Experience in Consulting and Presales, including client engagements.
* Demonstrated Sales acumen, with the ability to support deal closure and communicate value effectively.
* Project Management capabilities to coordinate cross-functional efforts and ensure timely delivery of proposals.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
* Comfort working on-site in a fast-paced startup environment in Mumbai, with a collaborative and proactive mindset.
* Background in real estate, financial services, or technology-driven services is an added advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Economics, or a related field; an advanced degree is a plus.
* Proficiency with productivity and presentation tools (e.g., Excel, PowerPoint, CRM platforms).

a87ae94a.description:

Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation & ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**You're Our Person If...**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
  
  
Posting Statement
  
  
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

* Experience with MPI, UCX or similar parallel programming frameworks.
* Strong understanding of multithreading, synchronization, IPC and distributed computing.
* Experience with GPU inference platforms such as NVIDIA Triton.
* Hands-on experience with performance profiling tools such as VTune, perf, NVIDIA Nsight, etc.
* Experience with low-level optimization, vectorization, intrinsics and cache-aware programming.

704e0320.title: Cloud Solution Architecture - M365, Copilot
704e0320.description:
**Overview**
With more than 45,000 employees and partners worldwide, the Customer Experience and Success (CE&S) organization is on a mission to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products and services, ignited by our people and culture. We drive cross-company alignment and execution, ensuring that we consistently exceed customers’ expectations in every interaction, whether in-product, digital, or human-centered. CE&S is responsible for all up services across the company, including consulting, customer success, and support across Microsoft’s portfolio of solutions and products. Join CE&S and help us accelerate AI transformation for our customers and the world.
  
  
The Global Customer Success (GCS) organization is leading the effort to create the desired customer experience through support offer creation, driving digital transformation across our tools, and delivering operational excellence across CE&S.
  
  
As a Cloud Solution Architect aligned to Factory delivery, you will enable customers to achieve their outcomes based on their investments in Microsoft technology. Leveraging your Microsoft Copilot Studio technical subject matter expertise, you will lead technical conversations with customers and Microsoft colleagues, driving value to their organization. This is a hands-on role that includes accelerating customer adoption by building Agentic AI solutions and identifying resolutions to unblock customer success projects for the AI Factory. You will also drive product influence with Engineering through technical feedback via the[MR1.1][PR1.2][PR1.3] factory. This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, honing your technical and program management skills, and deepen your cloud expertise.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
CSAs are senior individual contributors who operate globally and engage directly with customers. It is a hands-on technical role spanning across design, build, and production with a focus on issue resolution to remove customer production blockers. Candidates are expected to comfortably switch from a whiteboard to the keyboard. This is a truly exciting role that will feature unique and challenging technical problems to solve and to help our customers succeed.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Customer-Centric Approach:
  
  

* Play a pivotal role in the AI Cloud Accelerate Factory, providing technical enablement, operational support, and strategic engagement across customer projects. This role is designed to ensure successful delivery of AI solutions built on Copilot Studio, troubleshoot complex issues, and support innovation through pilot evaluations and advanced use case development. Understand customers' overall data estate, business priorities, and IT success measures. Innovate with Agent solutions that drive business value.
* Facilitate scalable delivery through strong technical program management utilizing a factory model/approach, driving program awareness and demand across the regional operating units. Attend in-flight project status meetings to monitor progress and identify support needs. Engage directly with complex or non-standard customer use cases beyond existing accelerators. Participate in intake reviews for milestone sizing, objection handling, and technical scoping.
* Ensure Solution Excellence: Deliver solutions with high performance, security, scalability, maintainability, repeatability, reusability, and reliability upon deployment. Gather insights from customers and partners and maintain a high CSAT.

**Business Impact**

* Usage (Cloud & Support) Growth: Develop opportunities to drive Customer Success business results by working with business and technical decision makers to ensure they understand Microsoft 365, Copilot and Copilot Studio value proposition and get value from their investment in Microsoft technology.
* Resolution of Customer Blockers: Identify resolutions to issues blocking go-live of customer success projects by leveraging deep knowledge of Microsoft 365 services & technical subject matter expertise. Lead technical conversations with customers to drive value from their Microsoft 365 investments and implement AI Agents. Deliver all work according to Factory best practices & policies and using repeatable IP.
* Architect Copilot Studio Agent Solutions: Apply technical knowledge to design solutions aligned with business and IT needs. Create Innovate with Agent roadmaps, lead POCs and MVPs, and ensure long-term technical viability.

**Technical Leadership**

* Advocate for Customers: Share insights and best practices, collaborate with the Factory team to address key blockers, and influence improvements, roadmap and feature prioritization.
* Resolve technical blockers: Debug technical issues and provide fixes for engagements encountering blockers.
* Learn It All: Demonstrate Self Learner mindset through continuous alignment of individual skilling to team/area demands and Customer Success goals.
* Continuous Learning: Stay updated on market trends, collaborate with the technical community, and educate customers about the Copilot Studio capabilities and platform.
* Accelerate Customer Outcomes: Through engaging with field teams, share expertise, drive factory nomination pipeline, and promote Factory to accelerate customer success, as well as collate feedback upon execution to drive improvement and leverage field teams inputs.

**Business Process Analysis**

* Depict customer business processes and prepare for the analysis and improvement of business process performance.
* Articulate, demo, and present complex customer concepts to varying audiences, such as BDMs (Business Decision Makers) & ITDMs (Information Technology Decision Makers).
* Experienced in delivery management, opportunity qualification, stakeholder communication, and partner engagement, including opportunity and pipeline mgmt.
* Experience in ensuring customers realize value by consuming technology.
* Collaboration & field Engagement: Experienced in collaborating in virtual teams to develop and drive M365 Copilot usage opportunities through influence. Identify and document best practices and customer references/ Winwires.

**Qualifications**
Required/Minimum Qualifications
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or related field AND 8+ years’ experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, Microsoft Azure business Solutions, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or Business Applications consulting OR equivalent experience.
  
  
**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**
Breadth of technical experience and knowledge in foundational security, foundational AI, architecture design, with depth / Subject Matter Expertise in one or more of the following:
  
  

* Deep Domain Expertise in M365 Areas: Deep domain expertise in one or more of the M365 specific areas, such as Microsoft IQ understanding, Connectors, MCP Servers and Copilot Studio OR hands-on experience working with the respective products at the expert level.
* Low Code development experience - Power Platform experience is needed. Copilot 365 and Teams background is useful for the role
* 8+ years experience working in a customer-facing role and on technical M365/Power Platform/Copilot Studio projects.
* Architecting Enterprise-Grade Solutions: Deep knowledge of solution architecture, design, implementation, and/or support of Cloud/collaboration environments.
* Certification in one or more of the following technologies preferred: M365 fundamentals, M365 Copilot fundamentals, Microsoft Power Platform/Copilot Studio platforms, Microsoft Azure fundamentals, Cloud Security, AI Business Professional and AI Transformation Leader, AI Fundamentals.
* Fluency in SaaS solutions; particularly all Microsoft 365 offerings.
* Domain experience Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Azure solutions, and understanding of how Microsoft Security, compliance, and identity solutions that can span across these solution areas to provide a holistic and end-to-end solution.
* Competitive Landscape knowledge of cloud and AI platforms. Understanding of M365 partner ecosystems and creation of Agents to solve customer needs.
* Breadth of technical experience and knowledge, with depth / SME in two or more of the following M365 solutions.
* M365 Copilot
* Power Platform/Copilot Studio
* Azure Foundry
* IDM, Information Protection & Compliance.
* Governance & Risk Management
* Agentic Workflows: Familiarity with Agent Framework, MCP, Langchain, or other agentic frameworks.
* Generative AI and Responsible AI: Foundational knowledge of current and emerging AI technology, including Generative AI technology applications and use cases (including, but not limited to, Large Language Models) and Foundational models toolsets.
* Understanding of Responsible AI practice including ethical considerations, bias mitigation, and fairness.
* Competitive Landscape: Understanding the competitive landscape is valuable; candidates should be aware of key AI platforms beyond Azure, such as AWS and GCP.
* Collaboration and Communication: Acknowledged for driving decisions collaboratively, resolving conflicts and ensuring follow through with exceptional verbal and written communication skills.  Presentation skills with a high degree of comfort with both large and small audiences.

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and / or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire / transfer and every two years thereafter.
  
  
This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

ef8a5594.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Fulfillment By Amazon (FBA)
ef8a5594.description:
**Description**
Ready to do something big?
  
  
How would you build the next generation of mission-critical systems and services that power the ability to send, store, and manage billions of products across the globe on behalf of our selling partners?
  
  
Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is the Amazon service for worldwide sellers that offers access to Amazon's vast distribution network as a service. Similar to how AWS provides infrastructure as a service, FBA allows sellers to only pay for what they use, leveraging our world-class infrastructure. Sellers in 135 countries worldwide, from Fortune 50 companies to hundreds of thousands of small businesses and entrepreneurs, rely upon our technology to grow and thrive on Amazon's Marketplaces.
  
  
In a very real way, we are changing lives with the work we do. FBA team members wake up every day thinking about how to enable our sellers to be successful by building highly scalable and highly reliable platforms. Enabling seller success allows us to provide Amazon customers with unparalleled selection and pricing. FBA is a win for sellers and a win for customers.
  
  
What is Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA)?
  
  
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IAi4fPb\_kp4&t=2s
  
  
The Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) team
  
  
https://vimeo.com/80948105
  
  
Third-party sellers have become one of Amazon's greatest growth engines, outpacing our own first-party retail business for years. That success did not happen by accident. We invested in building the best possible selling tools — from inventory management and payment processing to shipment tracking, reporting, and cross-border commerce — and we continue to invent new ones every year. FBA and the Prime membership program sit at the heart of that effort, dramatically improving the customer experience of buying from independent sellers and unlocking growth for businesses of every size.
  
  
As a Principal Technical Program Manager with FBA, you will lead broad cross-organization efforts from the early stages through release. You will work closely with product managers, engineering managers, scientists, and engineers to build the next generation of seller platforms. You will be responsible for influencing the organization's product and technical roadmap and technical architecture. You will drive organization-wide engineering and operational excellence initiatives, represent difficult trade-off decisions and solutions clearly to senior leaders, and leverage your technical knowledge to guide technical choices. You will manage cross-functional and cross-organization communication to ensure all stakeholders are informed and needs are aligned, guiding technical direction to deliver solutions that meet Amazon's high standards for customer satisfaction, efficiency, stability, extensibility, simplicity, and operational excellence.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Lead broad, cross-organizational programs from strategy definition through delivery, owning the technology roadmap for seller-facing platforms and driving alignment across product, engineering, and science teams.
* Define and decompose complex technical problems into clear solutions, assessing risk, driving clarity, and creating the right sense of urgency to keep programs on track.
* Influence the organization's product and technical architecture by applying deep system knowledge, identifying gaps across services and workflows, and proposing improvements that reduce repeated effort year over year.
* Partner with senior leadership to communicate trade-offs, present options, and drive decisions — managing cross-functional stakeholder alignment and escalating with strong judgment when necessary.
* Amplify your impact by mentoring other technical program managers, driving adoption of program management best practices, and contributing to the broader technical community.

A day in the life
  
  
Your primary focus will be guiding large-scale, cross-team programs that directly shape how millions of sellers interact with Amazon's fulfillment network. You will spend your time working across product managers, engineering leaders, and scientists — aligning priorities, unblocking technical decisions, and ensuring delivery stays on course. Expect a mix of deep technical design reviews, strategic roadmap discussions with senior leaders, and hands-on problem solving when programs hit ambiguity.
  
  
**About The Team**
The FBA team builds and operates the platforms that enable sellers in 135 countries to store, ship, and manage billions of products through Amazon's global fulfillment network. Our mission is straightforward: make sellers successful so customers get the selection and value they expect. We are investing in the next generation of seller tools and infrastructure, and this role will be central to shaping that future. If you want to work on programs that operate at massive scale and have a direct impact on both sellers and customers worldwide, this is the team for you.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 5+ years of software development experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience managing technical programs across cross-functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

0f3fb83f.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Business Data Technologies
0f3fb83f.description:
**Description**
We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to join the Data Access Controls team in Business Data Technologies (BDT). You will own and drive complex programs that define how Amazon's largest data lake is governed, ensuring the right people see the right data at the right time.
  
  
You will partner with AWS teams, Amazon security and compliance organizations, and multiple engineering teams to deliver governance solutions used by hundreds of thousands of data consumers. You will drive large outcomes by influencing across organizational boundaries, creating structure in ambiguous spaces, and shipping programs that balance security with usability.
  
  
This role requires someone who is equally comfortable in technical architecture discussions and stakeholder alignment meetings. You will need to understand distributed systems, data access control models, and policy frameworks well enough to challenge designs, identify risks early, and make trade-offs that protect customer trust without creating unnecessary friction.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own complex, multi-quarter programs end-to-end, from requirements through delivery to adoption, spanning engineering, product, UX, and compliance teams
* Drive cross-organizational alignment with policy steward organizations (Privacy, InfoSec, Legal) to rationalize, design, and onboard new compliance policies into the access control system
* Run large-scale adoption campaigns coordinating hundreds of dataset owner teams to classify data and enable governance controls
* Partner with AWS service teams to design solutions that work within and extend their capabilities
* Define and track program metrics and drive measurable improvements
* Identify technical risks in system designs and ensure current implementations do not block future architectural evolution
* Create clarity and structure in high-ambiguity domains where governance requirements, technical constraints, and customer experience must be balanced simultaneously
* Influence engineering architecture decisions and drive technical trade-offs across teams without direct authority
* Communicate program status, risks, and decisions effectively to senior leadership

A day in the life
  
  
We own the fine-grained access control system that governs every analytical query across Amazon's data lake: policy definition, access requests, approval workflows, permission enforcement, and renewal. We're building toward self-service governance where data owners control their own access policies without bottlenecks, and pioneering access controls for AI and multi-modal data (images, video, audio, ML artifacts), a space with no industry playbook.
  
  
**Why This Role Is Compelling**
High ambiguity: we're defining new governance primitives, not just implementing specs
  
  
Every improvement directly impacts hundreds of thousands of data consumers or strengthens Amazon's security posture
  
  
Cross-cutting influence: you'll partner with Privacy, InfoSec, Legal, and every SDO data team
  
  
The problems are genuinely hard: balancing security with usability, scaling fine-grained controls without drowning consumers in friction, designing abstractions that hold across column-based, row-based, and identity-resolved policies
  
  
You'll shape the roadmap, not just execute it
  
  
**About The Team**
We own the fine-grained access control system that governs every analytical query across Amazon's data lake: policy definition, access requests, approval workflows, permission enforcement, and renewal. We're building toward self-service governance where data owners control their own access policies without bottlenecks, and pioneering access controls for AI and multi-modal data (images, video, audio, ML artifacts), a space with no industry playbook.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

**About Ethos**
Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
  
  
**About The Role**
At Ethos our Technical Program Managers operate within the Engineering organization and have technical knowledge that enables them to influence and drive cross-team projects and roadmaps. The ideal candidate will be an excellent communicator, comfortable in a flat, fast-moving organization, and eager to collaborate to solve difficult challenges and display high agility to allow you to pivot as you lead the company's most pressing initiatives. In order to thrive in the role we are looking for an individual who is highly organized, and able to thrive and produce in high-pressure, time-sensitive scenarios.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Develop and manage end-to-end project plans and ensure on-time delivery
* Partner closely with engineering and product leads to evolve Ethos' product strategy and development
* Provide hands-on program management during analysis, design, development, testing, implementation, and post implementation phases
* Drive internal process improvements within the team
* Provide day-to-day coordination for projects and tasks
* Perform the duties of a Scrum Master using agile methodologies and scrum practices
* Assist teams with having a detailed understanding of agile and scrum framework
* Participate and facilitate roadmapping, sprint planning sessions, retrospectives, demos, and scrum of scrums
* Help teams understand and balance dependencies between performance, efficiency, and product functionality
* Map dependencies and relationships between projects and teams, coordinating efforts across organizations and verticals
* Communicate status and big picture to the stakeholders and leadership
* Work independently with minimal supervision

**Qualifications And Skills**

* 5+ years knowledge/work as a Project or Program Manager in product development environment
* BA/BS degree or equivalent work experience

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the SF Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with arrests and conviction records.
  
  
To learn more about what information we collect and how it may be used, please refer to our California Candidate Privacy Notice.

Full-time

$130,000 – $210,000 (USD equivalent), plus benefits.

cc0b1e94.description:
**About the Company**

Our Client is looking for a Presales Consultant / AI Product Manager to join our business and provide presales support to our customers. This role plays a key role in building customer confidence, addressing technical concerns, and winning sales opportunities.

**About the Role**

As an AI Agent Product Manager you’ll own each stage of the AI Agent building and deployment process for the largest consumer enterprises. You’ll work directly with VP and C-level executives to shape their AI roadmap, write and test prompt logic for high-impact use cases, and collaborate with engineering to design new product features. This is a role for someone who thrives on diving deep into complex business problems, crafting elegant AI-driven solutions, and scaling them to millions of users.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the deployment of Voice AI Agents for some of the largest consumer enterprises globally, ensuring AI agents become mission-critical to how millions of customers are engaged.
* Design and optimize enterprise-grade agents by mapping business workflows, writing and testing prompt logic, and collaborating with engineering to deliver precise, scalable solutions that handle thousands of conversations daily.
* Engage deeply with customers, from discovering requirements and demonstrating solutions, to addressing technical challenges, and tailoring agents to their business processes.
* Act as a trusted partner to VP and C-level executives, guiding their AI roadmap, aligning deployments with strategic goals, and ensuring measurable impact on revenue, efficiency, and customer experience.
* Own a portfolio of enterprise deployments end-to-end, driving adoption, expansion, and long-term success by partnering closely with internal teams and customer stakeholders.
* Run high-velocity feedback loops into Product and Engineering, channeling real-world insights to shape the roadmap, resolve friction, and accelerate adoption at scale.

**Qualifications**

* 4–8 years of relevant experience in AI Implementation, Product Management, Strategy Consulting, or Solutions Engineering ideally in AI-native companies or adjacent domains.
* Strong technical acumen with the ability to understand and shape AI agent design & prompt writing.
* Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, comfortable engaging with executive stakeholders.
* Ability to thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where you help shape solutions as much as you deliver them.
* (Preferred) Background in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent technical experience.

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Senior Cloud AI Platform Engineer to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
**Job Profile:** Senior Cloud AI Platform Engineer
  
  
**Job Summary:**  
We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Cloud AI Platform Engineer to architect, build, and operate enterprise-scale AI platforms across multi-cloud environments. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platform engineering, DevSecOps automation, AI/LLM model serving, GPU infrastructure, and platform reliability. This role will focus on delivering secure, scalable, and high-performing AI platforms that support modern AI and GenAI workloads.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Design, implement, and manage cloud-native AI platforms across Azure and GCP.
* Deploy and administer Kubernetes and OpenShift environments for enterprise AI workloads.
* Develop Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions and automate platform provisioning using Terraform and CI/CD pipelines.

* Optimize GPU infrastructure, resource utilization, and performance for AI workloads.
* Develop automation solutions, APIs, and platform services using Python and REST-based integrations.
* Implement secure authentication, authorization, and API management frameworks.
* Establish observability, monitoring, and reliability standards across AI platforms.
* Collaborate with Data Science, Engineering, Security, and Operations teams to deliver scalable AI solutions.
* Drive platform governance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Primary Skills:**  
1. Cloud Platforms (Azure, GCP)
  
2. Kubernetes OpenShift (GKE, AKS, OCP)
  
3. Infrastructure as Code DevSecOps (Terraform, CI/CD)
  
4. Python API Engineering (REST, SDKs, Automation)
  
5. AI/LLM Platform Engineering Model Serving (vLLM, Triton, TGI)
  
6. GPU Infrastructure Performance Optimization
  
7. Identity, Security API Gateway Integration (OAuth2, Service Accounts)
  
8. Observability Reliability Engineering (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Arize)
  
  
Secondary Skills
  
  
1. Agentic AI MCP Architectures
  
2. LiteLLM and Model Routing Frameworks
  
3. NVIDIA AI Ecosystem (NIM, NeMo, DGX, SuperPOD)
  
4. Vector Databases RAG Solutions

6. AI FinOps Capacity Management
  
7. Distributed Systems Scalability Engineering
  
8. AI Platform Productization Operational Excellence
  
  
About NTT DATA
  
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs.
