da2e729c.title: Service Delivery Manager - Offshore
da2e729c.description:
**Company Description**
Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,200 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 15 million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.
  
  
**Job Description**
Service Delivery Manager – MSP (SDM) is the focal point of driving the overall technical services delivery to any MSP customer from Day 1 as the project goes live. SDM is introduced as the SPOC from Technical Services at the beginning of the new logo implementation through any of the packages available with Nexthink. As the project enters the run phase, the SDM manages the delivery of scoped Managed Services (hereafter referred to as “Accelerate”) to Nexthink’s MSP Partner & their end customer. They play a pivotal role in supporting the MSP & their customer to realise value from the Nexthink platform. The SDM is supported by one or more Professional Services Consultants (PSC) as well as other support functions like Partner Success Manager, Product Managers, Product Support and more over, backend teams creating new content over the Nexthink platform. The objective of SDM is to ensure that Accelerate services are aligned with the customer success plan, and the value metrics being tracked for the customer, ensuring a continuous value delivery to the customer.
  
  
The role will coordinate the daily activities of the assigned PSCs, along with the other supporting Accelerate teams located globally and focus on the highest priorities and the biggest impact to the customer, while providing quality assurance, and delivering within the agreed service levels.
  
  
The role is a combination of technical and business skills; in which the candidate would work with the MSP & their customer right from doing DEX Management planning, document mutually agreeable success parameters, assigning BAU tasks to Accelerate PSCs and setting a governance to track the achievements of set goals & ultimately, document and present value achieved to the customer. The candidate should have the ability to assess technical requests, have meaningful discussions with customer on their objectives and map the same back to different product features / packages offered by Nexthink. SDM would be responsible to create and drive the Service Delivery Strategy for the customer and would work internal and external stakeholders across the customer and partner organizations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for the Managed Service Provider (MSP) and their customer, overseeing all deliverables outlined in the Services contract.
  
  
Participate actively in Customer Steering Group meetings, collaborating with the MSP to discuss Nexthink's role in the customer's Digital Experience (DEX) strategy, understand the partner / customer’s priorities and effectively, ensure timely and qualitative delivery of services.
  
  
Provide guidance to the PSC & MSP to drive the Business as Usual (BAU) operations. Recommend new business use cases and engage with the customer / MSP to increase adoption of Nexthink.
  
  
Analyze customer’s business needs & pain areas through regular connects, understanding of TCDs from Service Desk & various data seen from Nexthink. Identify opportunities to increase automation of issues & leverage existing as well as custom created contents to deliver value to the customer’s / MSP business.
  
  
Gain a deep understanding of the customer's business goals and objectives as outlined in the MSP contract, aligning Nexthink's deliverables with these objectives.
  
  
Comprehend the customer's DEX goals, strategic plans, pain points, and limitations to offer informed advice on leveraging Nexthink effectively.
  
  
Conduct thorough analysis of Nexthink data and present actionable insights to the customer. Create well documented presentations, capturing insights from data and provide recommendations.
  
  
Organize and coordinate for regular governance calls with MSP as well as bi-monthly / quarterly business review meetings with a focus on getting things done, based on CSP and mutually agreed road-map.
  
  
Collaboratively plan the Customer Success Plan and strategy with the PSM, Sales team, PSC & SC regularly; ensure to update the CSP based on the customer’s priorities.
  
  
Lead and manage the PSC / PSCs assigned to specific projects, ensuring their tasks and goals align with the Customer's Success Plan (CSP).
  
  
Identify and advocate for automation opportunities that bring value to the customer. Prioritize and request custom automation or report creation as needed, working backend with the other support teams of Accelerate.
  
  
Develop content tailored to customer requirements, collaborating with the Shared Services team for custom scripting, reports using external tools with Nexthink data, custom NQL queries.
  
  
Support customer initiatives related to Nexthink operations, including existing and upcoming projects. Encourage customer participation in Technical Previews of new features.
  
  
Organize regular product roadmap workshops to keep customers informed about new features and modules.
  
  
Meet Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and take prompt action, including internal escalations or partner notifications, in case of any impacts on SLO achievement.
  
  
Identify and fulfill agreed-upon use cases, consistently delivering results quarter after quarter.
  
  
Validate any new service / content requirements from the partner and raise the records in JIRA ticketing system. Assign tasks to self or PSC, post validation.
  
  
Establish and maintain a regular communication cadence with the MSP and customer through weekly, monthly, and quarterly meetings, ensuring that progress is tracked by PSCs.
  
  
Maintain updated Action Trackers & other relevant documents on OneDrive, including customer related insights and roadmap discussions. Update Salesforce records as required.
  
  
Prepare all customer-facing and internal deliverables, ensuring they meet high-quality standards.
  
  
Coordinate and communicate with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Support, and Partner Success, to align Managed Services activities.
  
  
Increase the footprint of Nexthink across different functions of the customer, within IT as well as non-IT related usage. Enhance stickiness of Nexthink to ensure smooth renewal and possible product upsells.
  
  
Escalate issues internally and externally when necessary to ensure prompt resolution. Follow-up with Product Support or relevant resolver groups to ensure timely resolution of issues raised. Raise RED FLAGS to alert in case of any deviations.
  
  
Stay informed about product development and releases at a level necessary to fulfill the above responsibilities, and inspire PSCs to innovate continuously to maximize Nexthink's value.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering preferred.

**Experience:**

* 8 - 10 years of experience in technical consulting, analytics, and automation, with a preference for candidates with this background.
* Consulting-based approach in previous roles coupled with good project management skills.
* Knowledge of Nexthink / competing products would be an advantage.
* Flexible to work in UK / US shifts

**Key Skills and Attributes:**

* Analytical Expertise: Proficient in analyzing data to identify pain points and opportunities, with a strong commitment to providing actionable insights and driving automation.
* Transformation Experience: Demonstrated experience in transformation projects, such as Win10 and O365 migrations.
* End User Computing (EUC) Mastery: Extensive technical knowledge of end user computing (EUC) management.
* Collaborative Aptitude: Skilled at collaborating with dispersed teams, including CTOs, product management, and support, to deliver the right solutions and innovate based on customer input.
* IT Operations Proficiency: Deep understanding of IT operations.
* Quick Learner: Ability to rapidly acquire knowledge of new technologies.
* Customer-Centric: Proven ability to gather and manage customer feedback, comprehend customer pain points, and propose practical solutions.
* Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a strong ability to engage with customers and collaborate effectively within a team.
* Problem Management: Exceptional problem-solving skills to address complex issues effectively.
* Adaptability: Capability to excel in challenging environments and adapt to changing circumstances.
* Enthusiasm for Innovation: Passion for working in an international, collaborative, and fast-paced environment and eagerness to learn and adopt new technologies.
* Technical Proficiency: Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Windows, Office 365, web browsers, and other standard EUC applications.

**Preferred:**

* Nexthink certified professional / previous experience of working with Nexthink or similar DEM tools.
* Practical knowledge of Windows, Office 365 & overall EUC insights
* Understanding of SQL, XML, PowerShell, PowerBI would be ideal.
* Practical experience of data integration methods and technologies

+ in any of the following:
+ IT systems
+ Enterprise infrastructure management / Data Centers
+ Application development and management
+ Managed IT Services
+ Security
+ Analytics – EU data

* Project Management skills (ITIL, PMP)

**Additional Information**
We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.
  
  
With over 1000 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.
  
  
If you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you! Check what we offer:
  
  

* 💼 Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package.
* 🩺 Health insurance through our partnership with ACKO, including OPD coverage for dental, vision, health check-ups, consultations, and pharmacy expenses.
* 🏡 Hybrid work model balancing office and remote work, with a structured approach for new hires to foster connections and onboarding.
* 🏖️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 22 days of holidays we offer). Plus, company-paid bank holidays (12), sick days (10-30), bereavement leave (5), and 3 days per year for volunteering.
* 📚 Free access to professional training platforms to explore your interests and enhance your skills.
* 🛡️ Stay covered against accidents, bodily injuries, and disabilities with our personal accident insurance policy, providing assurance with coverage up to three times your annual CTC.
* 🍼 New mothers are entitled to up to 26 weeks of maternity leave, with the flexibility to use up to 8 weeks before the expected delivery and the remaining 18 weeks after. Birth fathers can take 6 weeks of paternity leave, while adoptive parents are eligible for 26 weeks of leave for mothers and 6 weeks for fathers.
* 💰 Under the Payment of Gratuity Act, receive gratuity at the rate of 15 days of basic pay for every completed year of service, provided you've been employed by the company for a minimum of 5 years. Gratuity is payable at retirement or resignation based on your last drawn basic pay.
* 📣  Bonuses for referring successful hires after three months of continuous employment.

*Please note that not all the benefits listed above are available for temporary, contract, and internship roles. To ensure you have the most up-to-date information, we recommend checking with your Recruitment Partner.*

1c5147b1.title: Program Manager
1c5147b1.description:
**Role Summary**

Manage cross-functional programs of moderate complexity from planning through delivery. Work independently, proactively resolve issues, and communicate status clearly to stakeholders across different time zones. Use AI tools as part of the standard workflow.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own program plans, including milestones, dependencies, owners, timelines, and decision logs.
* Run program meetings, asynchronous check-ins, and reviews based on team requirements and distribution.
* Plan activities backward from target dates and flag timeline risks early, along with possible options.
* Proactively identify risks and gaps, including those not yet raised by task owners.
* Maintain risk registers, assess impact, track mitigation actions, and escalate issues with relevant context.
* Identify changes in scope or assumptions before they affect delivery.
* Provide operational updates to teams and concise status updates to managers.
* Maintain shared trackers and reference documents for distributed teams.
* Follow up on action items and ensure their closure.
* Use AI tools to draft communications, summarize meetings, and generate status reports.
* Identify and implement AI-assisted workflows to reduce friction across teams.
* Standardize repeatable program elements, including templates, intake processes, and review formats.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3–5+ years of experience in program management, project coordination, or operations.
* Experience proactively identifying risks, rather than only reporting issues raised by others.
* Experience coordinating distributed teams across different time zones.
* Strong written English, including status updates, decision summaries, and stakeholder briefs.
* Proficiency with collaboration and tracking tools such as Confluence, Jira, Asana, Smartsheet, or similar.
* Active working familiarity with AI productivity tools, including LLMs or AI-native applications.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in large enterprises or matrixed organizations.
* Familiarity with program health frameworks, RAG status, RAID logs, and risk registers.
* PMP, PMI-ACP, CAPM, or equivalent certification, or certification in progress.
* Experience coordinating asynchronously across APAC and US time zones.

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹1,300,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience you have in program management ?
* What is your current CTC ?
* What is your notice period ?

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Noida, Uttar Pradesh

Colliers (NASDAQ, TSX: CIGI) is a leading global diversified professional services company, specializing in commercial real estate services, engineering consultancy and investment management. With annual revenues exceeding $4.5 billion and $99 billion of assets under management, Colliers maximizes the potential of property, infrastructure and real assets to accelerate the success of our clients, investors and people.

**Job Description – Programme Manager**
At Colliers, we are committed to empowering exceptional talent to deliver world-class outcomes for our clients. As we continue to partner with some of the world’s most respected global organisations, we seek professionals who bring passion, precision, and leadership to every engagement. This role is a unique opportunity to work on a high-visibility programme with a globally recognised financial services client, where your expertise will directly influence project success, governance quality, and stakeholder confidence. If you thrive in fast-paced, high-performance environments and are ready to shape impactful workplaces, we would love to connect with you.

The Programme Manager will lead and govern a high-performance delivery programme for a global financial services client known for stringent quality, compliance, and schedule expectations. The role requires meticulous controls, transparent reporting, and exceptional stakeholder management to ensure delivery excellence across design, base build integration, and interior fit-out.

* Oversee all phases of project planning and delivery, ensuring alignment with global corporate standards and governance frameworks.
* Establish robust reporting mechanisms, risk registers, action logs, and change-control systems.
* Coordinate with the client’s global and regional stakeholders for approvals, audits, documentation, and compliance.
* Drive integration between base build and fit-out delivery to ensure seamless technical alignment.
* Lead project controls: cost management, scheduling, risk forecasting, and variance analysis.
* Manage design reviews, technical validations, quality benchmarks, and configuration standards.
* Monitor contractor performance, procurement timelines, commercial claims, and change orders.
* Ensure best-in-class HSE practices, documentation hygiene, and audit readiness.
* Lead and mentor cross-functional PM teams with clarity, discipline, and accountability.

* 10–15 years of Programme/ project management within corporate workplaces.
* Experience delivering for global clients with stringent governance standards.
* Degree in Architecture; PMP/ Prince2/ RICS preferred.

a013f31d.title: Solutions Consultant 2
a013f31d.description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Who We Are**
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Your Role The Solutions Consultant is the evolution of the traditional Sales Engineering role, aligning how we best serve our customers in understanding their environment, providing solution guidance and ensuring value realization in their investment with Palo Alto Networks. As a Solutions Consultant you provide technical leadership and expertise and guidance in your customer’s security transformation journey. You will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives and ensuring value realization of their investment with Palo Alto Networks. You evangelize our industry leadership in on-prem, cloud, and security operations services that establish PANW as your customer’s cybersecurity partner of choice. Responsibilities Meeting and exceeding sales quotas by building and implementing strategic, technical account plans that target cross-platform solutions Your ability to position, demonstrate and create high level designs across the entire PANW portfolio based on customer business needs Conducting discovery to understand and articulate the key technical, operational, and commercial imperatives of your prospects and customers Working closely with Professional Services, Customer Success and Specialist teams to ensure overall customer implementation and adoption of solutions Demonstrating strong communication skills and the ability to influence through effective presentations and customer-specific demos, technical engagements, and workshops Leading successful technical validation efforts based on best practices to ensure technical win in assigned opportunities Orchestrating supporting resources (Specialists, Channel Resources, Customer Support) to ensure a one-team approach that demonstrates a cohesive strategy Promoting end-to-end solutions that include PANW and/or partner professional services to ensure customers realize business value sooner Understanding the competitive landscape and effectively differentiating our leadership Continuously investing in yourself to develop technical and professional skills that drive your ever-increasing contributions to success of our customers while actively participating within the Solutions Consultant community and at industry events Identifying technical stakeholders and cultivating relationships with key personas to build and drive a security architecture transformation roadmap
  
  
**Qualifications**
Your Experience Having experience of 10+ years in handling Central government & Defence departments. Understanding of data networking and/or modern application design and cloud architectures Delivering cybersecurity solutions that solve technical challenges and influence new business initiatives Influencing and gaining buy-in from key stakeholders, either in a customer-facing or internal role; prior experience in a pre-sales role is ideal Handling Government tenders , RFP Management , connects in Central Government & Defence accounts & Government centric Partner ecosystem (Consulting Partners, SIs etc) Creating and delivering technical presentations, workshops, or technical validation engagements Partnering with Customer Support functions to ensure successful implementation and adoption of sold solutions Complex sales involving long sales processes with multiple buying centers and multi-product solutions are preferred Experience in selling, designing, implementing, or managing one or more of the following solutions: Network Security firewalls (i.e., hardware and virtual), proxy, IPS/IDS, sandboxing, URL filtering, and DNS security SASE, SaaS, CNAPP and/or SOC Transformation Technologies
  
  
**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
  
  
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

Scope and deliver AI search, knowledge-system and automation projects for clients in India, Canada and beyond.

Apply now LocationRemote (India or Canada) TypeFull-time TeamAI Solutions Apply by5 Jan 2027

**About the role**

Cogneet’s AI Solutions practice helps businesses in India, Canada and beyond put AI to work: being cited by answer engines, answering questions from their own documents and taking repetitive work off their teams’ desks. As AI Solutions Consultant you are the person clients meet first — you scope each project, run its four-week proof of value and stay with it until it is in production.

You work with Cogneet’s engineering and growth teams. The role is consultative, not research: you need to know what today’s models can and cannot do, and to say so plainly to a client.

**What you’ll do**

* Run discovery workshops and turn a client’s problem into a written scope, with the one metric the project will be judged on.
* Scope and deliver AI search optimization, knowledge-system and automation projects, working with our engineers on the build.
* Design the evaluation before the build: the test questions, the accuracy bar and the sources every answer must cite.
* Take each project from a four-week proof of value to production, including access control, logging and a handover to the client’s team.
* Write the weekly update and the monthly report, and brief our growth team on what AI visibility means for their channels.

**What you’ll bring**

* Four or more years in consulting, solutions engineering or technical product roles, with at least two AI or data projects taken from scoping to production.
* A working knowledge of large language models, retrieval, embeddings and evaluation — enough to challenge an engineer’s estimate.
* Python or TypeScript and SQL at prototype level.
* A clear grasp of the data-protection duties that apply when a client’s documents go into an AI system.
* Clear written and spoken English, and the confidence to run a workshop with a client’s leadership team.

**Nice to have**

* Hands-on work with India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, Canada’s PIPEDA or the GDPR.
* SEO or structured data, or projects measured on AI citation share.
* Automation platforms such as n8n, Make or Zapier, or an agent framework.

**What we offer**

af2f6073.title: Full Stack Architect & Backend Engineer - Technical Lead - OTT Platform Development
af2f6073.description:
**Company:** Meclusions Studio  
**Location:** Goregaon, Mumbai, Maharashtra  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 4–7 years preferred  
**Salary:** Salary will be decided depending on experience and demonstrated capability  
**Work Mode:** On-site

About Meclusions Studio

Meclusions Studio is developing a digital content and streaming platform focused on Sanatana, Hindu civilisation, Indian history, culture, traditions and knowledge through high-quality original storytelling.

Our planned content ecosystem includes documentaries, interviews, Travel programmes, 2D/3D animation, AI-assisted productions, short-form vertical videos and original OTT shows.

We are building our technology foundation with a lean, capable in-house team. Our goal is to use proven technologies and existing streaming infrastructure wherever practical, while retaining control over our product, source code, data and long-term development.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on **Full-Stack Product Engineer / Technical Lead** to design and develop the core technology behind our OTT platform.

You will be responsible for the backend architecture, APIs, databases, user accounts, content management, integrations and technical quality of the overall product.

You will work closely with our mobile/TV application developer and web platform engineer to build a connected ecosystem rather than several disconnected applications.

This is a practical product-development role, not just a supervisory position. You should be comfortable writing code, solving problems, making architectural decisions and guiding other developers.

Key Responsibilities1. OTT Backend & Architecture

* Design and develop a secure, scalable and maintainable backend.
* Build and maintain APIs used by our website, mobile applications and TV applications.
* Develop user authentication, profiles, permissions and account management.
* Design the content catalogue, categories, metadata, search and playlists.
* Implement watch history, continue-watching functionality and user entitlements.
* Plan for future subscriptions, premium content and access-control requirements.

2. Database & Content Management

* Design and maintain database structures.
* Develop or integrate a content-management/admin dashboard.
* Enable authorised team members to manage episodes, thumbnails, descriptions, categories, languages and publishing status.
* Maintain data integrity, access permissions and backup procedures.
* Ensure the platform can support both long-form programmes and short-form vertical videos.

3. Video Streaming Integration

* Integrate an established video hosting, encoding and delivery provider.
* Work with video playback APIs, streaming URLs, content metadata and access controls.
* Understand HLS/DASH streaming concepts, adaptive bitrate playback and CDN delivery.
* Implement appropriate security measures for protected content.
* Coordinate with the mobile/TV developer to ensure reliable playback across devices.

**Important:** We intend to leverage existing video infrastructure rather than build an entire transcoding and CDN system from scratch.

4. Website & Application Integration

* Develop and maintain backend services for the website and applications.
* Ensure consistent login, content data and user experience across platforms.
* Support integration with the mobile developer's Android/iOS and relevant TV applications.
* Work with payment/subscription integrations when required.
* Help establish analytics, crash reporting and product-performance monitoring.

5. Cloud, Deployment & Security

* Manage or oversee cloud hosting and deployment architecture.
* Set up development, testing and production environments.
* Use Git and a structured code-review process.
* Establish automated deployment where practical.
* Maintain logs, monitoring, backups and recovery procedures.
* Follow secure coding practices and protect user data.
* Document infrastructure, configurations and deployment procedures.

6. Vertical Video & Future Features

* Design backend support for a swipe-based vertical video feed.
* Support video categorisation, engagement tracking and viewing history.
* Prepare the architecture for future recommendations and personalisation.
* Ensure the system can evolve without unnecessary rebuilding.

7. Technical Leadership

* Work with a small in-house development team.
* Review code and establish practical engineering standards.
* Break requirements into achievable milestones.
* Estimate effort, identify technical risks and recommend cost-effective solutions.
* Coordinate external specialists when a particular platform requires expertise outside the core team.
* Maintain technical documentation so the company is not dependent on one individual's undocumented knowledge.

Required Skills

* Strong experience in backend or full-stack development.
* Practical experience designing and consuming REST APIs.
* Experience with databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL or equivalent.
* Knowledge of authentication, authorisation and secure application design.
* Experience with Git and collaborative development.
* Understanding of cloud hosting, deployment and application monitoring.
* Ability to debug production issues.
* Good communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables.

**Preferred Skills**

Experience with one or more of the following:

* Node.js/TypeScript, Python, PHP/Laravel or another suitable backend stack.
* React, Next.js or equivalent frontend technologies.
* AWS, Google Cloud, Azure or comparable hosting infrastructure.
* Docker and CI/CD.
* Video streaming APIs and CDN integrations.
* HLS/DASH playback concepts.
* OTT, video-on-demand, subscription or media applications.
* Payment gateways and subscription billing.
* Analytics and event tracking.
* AI APIs and automation integrations.

We do not require every technology listed above. Strong fundamentals and evidence of successfully delivered products are more important than familiarity with a long list of tools.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who:

* Has built and maintained real software products.
* Can make sensible architecture decisions without overengineering.
* Understands the difference between a working prototype and a production-ready application.
* Can balance development speed, quality, security and cost.
* Is comfortable working in a small, growing company.
* Can explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical management.
* Values documentation, maintainability and company ownership of code.

**What This Role Is Not**

This is not a position for someone who only manages developers without technical involvement.

We are looking for a hands-on engineer who can build the core system and help the team deliver it.

You will not be expected to personally build every mobile and TV application, design every screen, repair all office computers or develop a proprietary streaming engine. Responsibilities will be shared across the technical team and external specialists where appropriate.

**What We Offer**

**Description**
Are you passionate about transforming tax technology through innovation? Amazon's Direct Tax Technology team is seeking a Solutions Architect II to revolutionize how tax professionals work. In this role, you'll leverage modern technologies including Python and generative AI to design and implement solutions that empower Amazon's Direct Tax Reporting and Compliance organization. You'll tackle complex technical challenges at unprecedented scale, building world-class systems that drive efficiency and enable tax professionals to meet Amazon's unique global challenges.
  
  
This is an opportunity to make a significant impact by architecting solutions that transform tax operations for one of the world's most innovative companies. You'll work at the intersection of tax domain expertise and modern cloud technologies, creating elegant technical solutions that directly improve how Amazon's tax team operates at a global scale.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Design and implement scalable tax technology solutions using Python, generative AI, and modern development practices to solve complex tax processing challenges
  
  
Define front-end architectures and user experiences, owning specific technical components while establishing best practices for model development and solution design
  
  
Collaborate with tax professionals, Product Managers, and fellow Solutions Architects to translate customer requirements into technical specifications that engineering teams can execute
  
  
Lead end-to-end solution architecture for tax technology projects, including planning, design, implementation, testing, and continuous process improvement as part of an autonomous team
  
  
Mentor and develop other Solutions Architects by sharing technical expertise, facilitating knowledge transfer, and contributing to team growth through code reviews and technical guidance
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
Your day blends creative problem-solving with hands-on technical work. You might start by architecting a generative AI solution to streamline tax compliance workflows, then collaborate with tax professionals to refine user experience requirements. After lunch, you'll dive into Python modeling to optimize data processing pipelines, followed by a design review where you mentor junior architects on best practices. The afternoon could include troubleshooting a technical challenge with your team, contributing to solution planning, and ending with a customer workshop where you demonstrate how new capabilities will transform their tax operations.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Direct Tax Technology team sits within Amazon's Tax organization and is dedicated to supporting tax professionals in the Tax Reporting and Compliance group with innovative technology solutions and streamlined processes. Our team tackles the unique and complex challenges that come with operating at Amazon's scale, building systems that enhance processing efficiency and empower our internal customers.
  
  
We foster a culture of innovation and collaboration where technical excellence meets business impact. Our mission is to continuously evolve tax technology capabilities, ensuring our tax professionals have the tools they need to succeed. Join a team where your work directly influences how Amazon manages tax compliance and reporting, and where you'll have opportunities to explore emerging technologies like generative AI while growing your skills alongside talented engineers and architects.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

* 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. aa7eaa9c.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
aa7eaa9c.description:
**Description**
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation & ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**You're Our Person If...**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

8a70e564.title: Salesforce, Lead IT Architect, Platinion
8a70e564.description:
**Locations**
: Gurgaon | Mumbai
  
  
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
**About BCG Platinion**
BCG Platinion's presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. We achieve digital excellence for clients with sustained solutions to the most complex and time-sensitive challenge. We guide clients into the future to push the status quo, overcome tech limitations, and enable our clients to go further in their digital journeys than what has ever been possible in the past. At BCG Platinion, we deliver business value through the innovative use of technology at a rapid pace. We roll up our sleeves to transform business, revolutionize approaches, satisfy customers, and change the game through Architecture, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Application and Risk functions. We balance vision with a pragmatic path to change transforming strategies into leading-edge tech platforms, at scale.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Salesforce Architect who can lead and deliver complex Salesforce solutions for our clients in various industries. You will define the Salesforce strategy, architecture, integration, development, and security of multiple Salesforce applications across sales, service, and marketing clouds. You will also work with senior client stakeholders, manage project teams, and collaborate with other vendors.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead the development of Salesforce strategies and architectures for clients in target industries such as Manufacturing, CPG, Industrial Goods, Financial Services, etc.
* Oversee the implementation of Salesforce solutions using Data, Marketing, Sales, service, experience, industry clouds (Field Service etc), and other Salesforce products
* Integrate Salesforce applications with external systems using identity and access management, data architecture, and best practice integration patterns
* Build secure and scalable apps using sharing architecture, LWC, Apex, Flow builder, and other development tools
* Advise clients on build vs. buy decisions, single-org vs. multi-org strategies, and DevOps practices on the Salesforce platform
* Work with CXO-level stakeholders to understand their business needs, present solutions, and manage expectations
* Lead business development and sales activities to generate new opportunities and expand existing relationships with clients
* Manage project teams, vendors, budgets, timelines, and quality assurance activities
* Stay updated on the latest trends and developments in Salesforce and CRM domains
* Develop trust-based relationships with clients as a trusted C-level advisor
* Lead the delivery of high-quality products that exceed client expectations
* Support the professional development of your team members through coaching and feedback
* Contribute to the intellectual capital of the firm by creating knowledge documents on a specific content platform

What You'll Bring
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* Minimum 8 t0 14 years of experience in IT Architecture, Technology transformation, Salesforce architecture and development
* Salesforce Application Architect and System Architect certifications
* Experience in leading and delivering complex Salesforce solutions using sales cloud, marketing cloud, service cloud, and marketing cloud for at least 5-10 clients in target industries
* Experience in integrating Salesforce applications with external data platforms (Data lakes, etc.), ERP systems (Manufacturing industry), CBS systems (Financial industry), LMS systems (Financial industry), analytical systems (Tableau, etc.), messaging systems (Kafka, etc.), and public cloud platforms (one major public cloud)
* Experience in working with Indian clients and organizations
* Strong understanding of CRM market and competitors (SFDC, MS Dynamics, Oracle, Zoho, etc.)
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Ability to travel as per requirement

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
  
  
BCG is an E - Verify Employer. Click here for more information on E-Verify.

**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Senior Lead, Anaplan Solutions & Planning Platforms**
  
  
*Job Description | Finance Technology*
**Position Summary**
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated
**Senior Lead, Anaplan Solutions & Planning Platforms**
to lead the implementation, support, and strategic expansion of enterprise planning solutions across Finance. This role will own delivery outcomes across Anaplan Staff Planning, Forecasting, CCAR support, Income Statement planning, Data Hub architecture, integrations, UX reporting, and future planning modernization capabilities.
  
  
The ideal candidate is not only a strong Anaplan expert, but also a capability builder who can establish delivery discipline, mentor a team, strengthen governance, and translate business priorities into scalable, controlled, and user-friendly planning solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
  
  

* Required Technical Skills & Experience
* Deep expertise in Anaplan solution architecture, model building, Data Hub design, ALM, UX development, and deployment management, with a proven ability to design scalable, high-performing enterprise planning solutions.
* Strong functional knowledge of FP&A, workforce planning, budgeting, forecasting, scenario modeling, and financial data management, with the ability to translate complex business requirements into actionable planning capabilities.
* Experience leading end-to-end implementation and enhancement of enterprise planning platforms, including requirements gathering, solution design, development, testing, deployment, governance, and production support.
* Proven ability to design and manage enterprise data integrations, leveraging APIs, SQL, and data analysis techniques to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and timely availability across planning ecosystems.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills with expertise in reporting, analytics, controls, access management, documentation, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and financial modeling, complemented by experience working within Agile delivery frameworks and modern Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence stakeholders, establish best practices, and drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance planning efficiency, data quality, and business outcomes.
* Leadership & Team Development
* Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing Anaplan delivery team comprising model builders, analysts, engineers, and solution SMEs.
* Establish clear ways of working across backlog management, sprint execution, release planning, quality reviews, documentation, and production support.
* Coach team members on Anaplan best practices, model design, data management, performance optimization, and business engagement.
* Create a sustainable capability model with role clarity, cross-training, succession planning, and measurable skill maturity.
* Strategy, Roadmap & Stakeholder Management
* Partner with Finance, FP&A, HR, Risk, Corporate Functions, and Technology stakeholders to define priorities, business outcomes, and delivery roadmap.
* Translate business needs into scalable Anaplan solutions that improve forecasting, workforce planning, scenario analysis, expense planning, and management reporting.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders by providing clear options, risks, dependencies, trade-offs, and recommendations.
* Lead prioritization forums and drive alignment across business value, regulatory needs, capacity, and technical feasibility.
* Solution Architecture & Delivery Ownership
* Own end-to-end design and delivery of enterprise Anaplan capabilities across Staff Planning, Forecasting, CCAR, Income Statement planning, cost center planning, and scenario modeling.
* Design scalable multi-model architectures using Data Hub, ALM, controlled data flows, modular design principles, and reusable planning components.
* Ensure models are performant, auditable, maintainable, secure, and aligned to Anaplan and enterprise technology standards.
* Oversee requirements, design, build, testing, UAT, deployment, documentation, and post-production stabilization.
* Platform Operations, Controls & Data Quality
* Strengthen production support, incident management, release governance, access controls, and operational risk management.
* Establish data validation, reconciliation, completeness checks, and error-handling processes across inbound and outbound planning data.
* Drive improvements in platform stability, data accuracy, business adoption, user experience, and planning cycle efficiency.
* Maintain strong documentation for model architecture, data lineage, integrations, controls, release records, and support procedures.

  
  

* Innovation & Continuous Improvement
* Identify opportunities to simplify planning processes, automate manual activities, enhance reporting visibility, and improve self-service capability.
* Evaluate and apply modern planning practices including predictive planning, advanced analytics, AI-enabled insights, and integration automation where appropriate.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, operational precision, accountability, and business-value driven delivery.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems
* 10+ years of experience in enterprise planning, financial systems, EPM platforms, FP&A technology, or related finance technology domains.
* 8+ years of hands-on Anaplan implementation, model building, and solution architecture experience.
* Proven experience leading enterprise-scale planning implementations from concept through production deployment.
* Strong working knowledge of FP&A, forecasting, budgeting, workforce planning, management reporting, cost center planning, and financial data structures.
* Anaplan Certified Solution Architect or Master Anaplanner credentials preferred.
* Experience with Hyperion, Oracle EPM, OneStream, SAP BPC, Workday, Power BI, SQL, ETL tools, APIs, or enterprise data platforms is good to have
* Experience in banking, financial services, regulatory planning, risk, CCAR, SOX-controlled environments, or large global enterprises.
* Strong Agile delivery experience and familiarity with SDLC, DevOps, change management, and release governance.
* Experience designing Data Hub architecture, integrations, validation routines, and controlled data flows.
* Demonstrated experience building, mentoring, and leading technical teams.
* Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.

  
  
**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

ebafe7dc.title: Application and Cloud Security Lead
ebafe7dc.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

Role Summary

The Application & Cloud Security Lead will serve as a key security leader within the S&P Global Energy Division BISO team, responsible for coordinating security initiatives across application, cloud, and AI-enabled environments. This role directly supports the protection of applications, data, systems, and reputation by proactively managing cyber risk, strengthening resilience and embedding security into everything we do.

The successful candidate will partner with technology, product, engineering, cloud, risk, compliance, and business stakeholders to ensure security is integrated into architecture, delivery, operations, and innovation. The role will focus on security architecture reviews, application security governance, cloud security enforcement, AI security oversight, risk remediation, and alignment with enterprise cybersecurity standards.

This position requires a hands-on security leader who can translate cybersecurity requirements into practical controls, influence engineering teams, guide secure design decisions, and drive measurable improvements in cyber resilience across the Energy Division.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead and coordinate application, cloud, and AI security initiatives across the S&P Global Energy Division in alignment with S&P Global's cyber risk management objectives.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for applications, APIs, cloud platforms, data flows, integrations, and AI-enabled solutions to identify risks and recommend secure design improvements.
* Partner with engineering, product, architecture, cloud, and business teams to embed security requirements into solution design, development, deployment, and operations.
* Enforce application security controls, including secure coding practices, vulnerability remediation, authentication, authorization, secrets management, dependency security, and software supply chain risk management.
* Oversee cloud security control implementation across public cloud environments, including identity and access management, network security, encryption, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and secure configuration.
* Review and assess AI and machine learning use cases for security risks, including data leakage, prompt injection, model exposure, access control, third-party AI risk, and misuse scenarios.
* Track, prioritize, and drive remediation of application, cloud, and AI security findings, exceptions, and risk acceptances in partnership with accountable technology owners.
* Support cyber risk assessments, compliance reviews, audit requests, and security reporting related to Energy Division applications, cloud services, and AI-enabled platforms.
* Develop and maintain metrics, dashboards, and executive-level reporting to communicate security posture, risk trends, remediation progress, and key security initiatives.
* Serve as a trusted security advisor and liaison between the Energy Division and Enterprise cybersecurity teams, promoting secure-by-design practices and consistent adoption of security standards.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelors degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 5-8+ years experience in cybersecurity, with a strong focus on application security, cloud security, security architecture, and/or technology risk management.
* Experience conducting security architecture reviews for applications, APIs, cloud platforms, data platforms, and enterprise technology solutions.
* Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD security, container security, Kubernetes security, infrastructure-as-code scanning, secrets management, and software supply chain security.
* Experience with cloud security tools such as CSPM, CWPP, CNAPP, SIEM, vulnerability management platforms, container scanners, and identity governance tools.
* Familiar with AI security concepts such as prompt injection, model access control, sensitive data exposure, model monitoring, adversarial testing, AI red teaming, and third-party AI risk.
* Experience working with public cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders including technology, product, risk, compliance, privacy, legal, and business teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical security risks to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to prioritise risks, influence remediation, and drive outcomes in a complex enterprise environment.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, SABSA, CCSK, Cloud Vendor Certifications (e.g. AWS Certified Security — Specialty, AWS Certified Solution Architect, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer) or equivalent credentials.

1914d2af.title: Cloud Operations Specialist (Ericsson CNIS & VMware) - BangaloreVOIS
1914d2af.description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking a Cloud Operations Specialist to join our Cloud Operations team supporting cloud environments that virtualise network functions within Vodafone's core network. The role focuses on the operational management, lifecycle support, security, reliability, and continuous evolution of multi-vendor cloud platforms across multiple markets. The successful candidate will work closely with engineering teams, design teams, vendors, and internal customers to ensure stable, secure, and efficient cloud infrastructure operations while driving platform improvements and supporting critical business services.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Manage and support cloud platforms including VMware vSphere, VMware Tanzu, VMware NSX, and Ericsson Cloud Native Infrastructure Solution (CNIS)
* Perform incident, change, problem, and service request management activities across multi-vendor cloud environments
* Troubleshoot critical platform issues and coordinate incident resolution to minimise service impact
* Implement security controls, remediate vulnerabilities, and ensure compliance with organisational standards and industry best practices
* Evaluate software releases, firmware updates, security patches, and platform upgrades
* Plan, organise, and coordinate major infrastructure upgrades and lifecycle management activities across multiple markets
* Collaborate with design, engineering, and delivery teams to align operational processes and platform roadmaps
* Support fault management processes and drive operational excellence across cloud environments
* Build effective working relationships with stakeholders, vendors, and internal customers
* Manage tasks and priorities effectively to meet operational and project deadlines while maintaining a strategic multi-market perspective
* Contribute to the lifecycle management and continuous improvement of cloud infrastructure platforms

**Who You Are**

* Experience in cloud operations, infrastructure operations, systems administration, or cloud platform management
* Strong expertise in Ericsson Cloud Native Infrastructure Solution (CNIS)
* Minimum 2 years of hands-on system administration or cloud administration experience with Ericsson CNIS
* Strong understanding of storage technologies, SAN infrastructure, and networking architectures
* Experience working with VMware technologies including VMware vSphere, VMware Tanzu, and VMware NSX
* Knowledge of incident, change, and problem management processes
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills in complex technical environments
* Effective stakeholder management and collaboration skills across geographically distributed teams
* Excellent organisational and time-management skills
* Fluency in English
* Ability to perform effectively during high-pressure situations and service-impacting incidents
* Demonstrated critical thinking and continuous learning mindset
* Collaborative team player with a problem-solving approach

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* Opportunity to work on large-scale cloud platforms supporting critical telecom network services
* Exposure to multi-vendor cloud technologies and cloud-native infrastructure environments
* Global stakeholder engagement across multiple Vodafone markets
* Participation in strategic infrastructure evolution, platform upgrades, and transformation initiatives
* Opportunity to work with cross-functional engineering, design, and operational teams
* Experience in managing enterprise-grade cloud infrastructure within a global technology organisation

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced cloud operations and lifecycle management practices
* Cloud-native infrastructure operations using Ericsson CNIS
* Enterprise VMware platform administration and optimisation
* Security remediation, vulnerability management, and operational compliance practices
* Multi-market service management and stakeholder collaboration
* Infrastructure upgrade planning, release management, and platform transformation methodologies
* Advanced incident response and operational resilience techniques

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.
  
  
**Alert**
Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud.
  
  
#JDEnhancedByTARA
  
  
**Follow us on social media**

* LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/vois/
* Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/voisglobal
* Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/voisglobal/

Anna Nagar, Chennai

Onsite

8–15 years

IT / Technology Services

We are looking for an experienced
**IT Program Manager**

This role combines program delivery, P&L ownership, process improvement, and strategic execution. The ideal candidate can bring structure to evolving environments, identify opportunities for improvement, and translate business priorities into scalable processes and measurable outcomes.

* Work closely with senior leadership on strategic initiatives, business reviews, and recommendations for new programs or service enhancements.
* Manage client and stakeholder relationships, ensuring clear communication, accountability, and effective resolution of delivery challenges.
* Navigate evolving priorities and drive initiatives from problem identification through implementation and measurable outcomes.

* Experience with P&L management, budgeting, margins, or commercial performance.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, analytical thinking, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to develop SOPs, streamline workflows, and implement processes that improve efficiency and accountability.
* A hands-on, adaptable approach to working in fast-paced environments with evolving priorities.
* Openness to constructive feedback, a commitment to continuous self-development, and a keen interest in emerging technologies and industry developments.

An opportunity to work directly with senior leadership, influence business decisions, and help shape the company's next phase of growth across program delivery, financial performance, and operational excellence.

0784c434.description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.
  
  
Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.
  
  
Job Description The Project Client Solutions Manager is a client facing role responsible for managing multiple projects of moderate complexity from initiation through completion. This role coordinates project teams, defines scope and objectives, allocates resources, develops schedules and maintains documentation that ensures timely delivery while maintaining business value. The position partners closely with business and technical stakeholders to translate business needs into practical and effective solutions.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Manage multiple projects, including defining and controlling project scope.
* Assemble project teams and assign individual responsibilities.
* Identify appropriate resources and develop detailed work plans, schedules, estimates, and resource plans.
* Create project documentation including a project plan with timeline and maintain timely to demonstrate outcomes.
* Negotiate with users, staff and management to define project objectives, priorities, and sequencing of work.
* Ensure completion of project deliverables and adherence to established timelines.
* Collaborate with business and technical staff to translate business needs into practical technology solutions, including business case development, data analysis, requirements and solution definition, root cause analysis, use case definition, and solution assessment.
* Support project design and planning activities, including reviewing business requests, validating business justifications, working with business leaders or submitters to address issues, applying prioritization frameworks, facilitating management discussions, and reporting progress.
* Ensure projects adhere to schedules while sustaining intended business value.
* Participate in the development of additional services planned by the unit.
* Recommend new business opportunities, systems, processes, and improvements; support research and strategy development; and implement improvements approved by senior management.
* Attend meetings related to ongoing and prospective projects.
* Identify, establish, and maintain effective business relationships.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and directly related experience.
* 2+ years of project management experience, including managing multiple concurrent projects of moderate complexity.
* PMP (Project Management Professional) certification preferred
* Lean Six Sigma (Green Belt or higher) preferred
* Excellent organizational, multitasking, project planning, timeline management, leadership, judgment, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to set goals and work independently with minimal direction.
* Demonstrated experience managing full project lifecycle (initiation through closeout).
* Experience working in a financial services environment preferred. Feb 12, 2026 9:43 AM Work Environment & Disclaimer This job operates in a professional office environment.
