3f1b5a03.title: Salesforce Field Service Architect
3f1b5a03.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
Our Field Service Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that craft the future.
  
  
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include--but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
As a core part of this role, you will realize solutions for our customers by focusing on consultancy, technical development & delivery for the customers and partners to solve critically meaningful business challenges using Salesforce’s Field Service Platform (SFS). Salesforce FS product provides FSM solutions for a wide variety of customer verticals and ecosystem(s) like Telecom, Utilities, Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, Finance etc.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**Requirements**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End-to-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
  
  
Posting Statement
  
  
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

d6c5b7aa.title: Solution Architecture - HCL Commerce
d6c5b7aa.description:
We're looking for a seasoned **Solution Architect** with HCL Commerce expertise to drive the design and evolution of a multi-tier B2B commerce platform, steering architecture decisions across legacy Commerce systems, Spring Boot services, and modern Next.js storefronts.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Establish and maintain target and transitional architecture for a multi-tier B2B commerce environment, spanning the WCS store, business logic, Commerce tools, Spring Boot APIs, and Next.js / React storefront
* Direct the design of dual-run / strangler patterns, deciding which journeys stay on WCS versus move to Next.js and services, while safeguarding routing, session, catalog, cart, and order consistency, and setting cut-over and rollback procedures
* Produce and review solution designs, sequence/integration diagrams, and interface contracts (REST/SOAP), catching reusability, performance, security, and operability concerns prior to build
* Work closely with product, delivery leads, QA, DevOps, and enterprise/integration teams on requirements gathering, data conversion, integration testing, and cut-over execution
* Define coding and design standards across Commerce customization, Spring Boot services, and the Next.js storefront so squads stay consistent
* Steer integration with back-end systems (ERP, payments, search, CMS, punchout / customer purchasing systems), preserving a clear boundary between Preview (authoring) and Runtime (customer-facing) Commerce environments
* Evaluate designs and pull requests spanning Commerce, services, and storefront layers, and trace complex cross-layer defects back to their root cause
* Offer guidance on capacity planning, caching strategies, search, and failure handling for a high-traffic B2B storefront
* Mentor senior engineers and leads, capturing architecture decisions along with their context, options considered, and consequences to maintain continuity
* Pinpoint major obstacles and use structured problem-solving techniques to tackle complex, multi-system issues

**Requirements**

* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Between 12 and 20 years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 5 years serving as an architect or in an equivalent principal/staff design capacity on large-scale commerce or comparably complex multi-tier systems
* At least 8 years of hands-on expertise with HCL Commerce and/or IBM WebSphere Commerce (WCS) 8.x, including store customization, commands/tasks, tools, catalog/order/user/organization workflows, and back-end integration
* At least 8 years of expertise in Java / J2EE and object-oriented design for large IT systems, with a strong preference for WebSphere Application Server experience
* At least 5 years working with Spring / Spring MVC, with practical Spring Boot architecture experience covering service boundaries, APIs, resilience, and authentication
* At least 5 years of experience building web services (REST and SOAP), including the ability to define contracts that other teams can implement against
* Hands-on production architecture experience with Next.js and React, covering routing, data fetching, BFF/API integration, and storefront performance optimization; TypeScript experience is preferred
* At least 5 years using source control systems, with Git experience required
* Preferred background in designing B2B commerce architecture, including punchout functionality, organization/user models, and complex contract/pricing logic
* Experience delivering work through Agile methods using Atlassian tooling (Jira, Bitbucket/Git, Confluence)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for engaging both technical and non-technical audiences

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with headless/composable commerce concepts (API-first storefronts, BFF, packaged capabilities) and iPaaS platforms such as MuleSoft
* Exposure to search technologies (Solr or similar), caching systems (Redis or similar), and CMS-powered storefronts (Optimizely or similar) working alongside a commerce engine
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (GKE/Kubernetes or similar) supporting storefront and Spring Boot deployments, plus WAS/IHS for Commerce
* Solid grasp of security practices, PCI-adjacent payment flows, and session/identity management spanning legacy and modern storefronts
* Prior involvement in dual-run initiatives or large-scale commerce migration efforts

ad332016.title: Delivery Lead (Project Management and Business Analysis)
ad332016.description:
**Delivery Lead (Project Management and Business Analysis)**

MasterTech Web Applications LLP, Thane

**Location:** Thane West, Maharashtra (in office)  
**Type:** Full time  
**Pay:** ₹58,000/- to ₹67,000/- thousand per month  
**Experience:** 4 to 7 years  
**Start:** November 2026

**MasterTech Web Applications** is hiring a **Delivery Lead** to run day to day delivery for a 7 to 10 person product and engineering team in Thane. The role is a hands-on, player-coach role that combines team/delivery lead responsibilities alongside that of a business analyst and a project manager. You turn the founder/CEO's direction into written requirements, plans and releases. You keep the team unblocked. You report progress every week verbally and in writing. You are the primary link between the US based founder and the team in the office.

You will plan, write, test, and chase deadlines alongside the team, and you will manage people as the team grows. The team is set to grow over the next 12 months, and this role grows with it.

**About MasterTech**

MasterTech Web Applications LLP is a 15-year-old software & venture studio in Thane. We have been profitable since our first year and we still are. We build and run our own products and we take on a small number of outside client projects. The portfolio today includes a consumer mobile app live on Google Play and the App Store, a B2C/B2B platform selling to US customers, a set of long running affiliate and content websites, the social media accounts that go with those products, and client builds across web, mobile and blockchain.

The founder is based in the United States and has been successfully running the organization since 2011. The current team in Thane is 8 to 10 people: a full stack development team, a product/service delivery team, a content and digital marketing specialist, a sales and customer success manager, and office administration along with two owner/partners who are very much involved in the overall operations. The team works in the office on Microsoft 365 with managed laptops, and uses AI assistants/tools every day for specs, test cases, code and reporting. We hire people who like that way of working and thrive to deliver at least 3x outcomes before scaling further from there.

The plan for the next two years is growth: more products, more client work, a bigger team. The Delivery Lead is the role that makes that growth run on time.

**What you will own**

**Delivery**

* Run the weekly delivery plan across all active workstreams: our own products, client projects and the affiliate sites. Keep the master Gantt current.
* Run the daily standup. Clear blockers the same day or escalate them the same day.
* Sign off QA before anything ships. Coordinate releases to Google Play, the App Store, hosting and client environments.
* Keep the product delivery team on its daily targets and quality bar.
* Plan and track the digital marketing work for our products and websites (SEO, paid search, content and email campaigns) with the content and marketing specialist, and report what it returns.
* Run the social media calendar for our product accounts (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, WhatsApp groups) with the team members who post and reply every day: content planned a week ahead, engagement and replies handled daily, follower and reach growth reported weekly.

**Business analysis and product management**

* Turn the founder's briefs, voice notes and chat threads into written requirements: user stories, acceptance criteria, screen flows, test cases.
* Own the product brief, success metrics and release plan for each product. Prioritize the backlog against business value and groom it weekly with the developers.
* Run UAT with the founder and with clients. Log defects, retest, close.
* Document how things work: processes, runbooks, release notes, handover docs.

**Project management**

* Estimate, schedule and track every project. Keep a live risk log.
* Send the founder a written status update every week: shipped, slipped, blocked, next.
* Own client communication for outside projects: scope, timelines, change requests, invoicing milestones.
* Track team hours and throughput per workstream so we know what each product costs to run.

**Team lead**

* Give day to day direction to 7 to 10 people across development, product delivery, marketing and social media.
* Hold a short weekly 1:1 with each team member. Give performance input to the founder.
* Onboard new hires. Coordinate attendance, leave and office matters with the office administrator & director(s).
* Run our internship program with support from the management team: 1 to 2 rounds a year of interns from local colleges, from college outreach and selection through onboarding, daily supervision, project assignment and completion sign off.
* Be the local hands for IT: laptop handoffs, asset register, policy sign offs, working with the founder who administers the tenant.
* Be available to connect with the US based founder at least 2 to 3 times a week on average, for 30 to 90 minutes, by phone or Zoom. Some weeks run more often, based on project and client needs. This is a requirement of the role.

**Must haves**

* 4 to 7 years in software or digital product delivery, with at least 2 years running web or mobile builds end to end.
* You have written user stories, acceptance criteria and test cases that developers built from. Bring a sample.
* You have shipped at least one mobile app through Google Play or App Store review, or one production web release with a client sign off.
* Product management basics: you can write a one page product brief, set success metrics, prioritize a backlog against business value and run a release.
* Working knowledge of digital marketing: SEO fundamentals, Google Analytics and Search Console, and how paid search campaigns are set up, budgeted and measured.
* Team management: You have managed a diverse team of at least 5 subject matter experts or individual contributors from two or more skill areas for at least two years and have conducted 1:1 performance conversations.
* You have managed and grown social media accounts for a product or brand (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, WhatsApp groups or similar): content calendars, daily posting and replies, follower and reach growth, and the tools that schedule and measure it. You will run this work through the team every day.
* Working fluency with Jira, ClickUp, Trello or Asana, a Gantt or roadmap tool, and Git basics (read a pull request, follow a branch). You do not need to code.
* Technical literacy: you can read an API doc, follow a database schema at a high level, and argue scope and tradeoffs with developers.
* Clear written and spoken English for daily work with a US founder and US clients. Fluency in Hindi or Marathi is required for ease of communication in the local region and outside staff, while maintaining use of English language for the office.
* You use AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot or similar) every day for specs, test cases, documentation and reporting, and you can show how.
* Based in Thane or Mumbai. In the office every working day, alternate Saturdays per the office calendar.
* Available for calls with the US based founder 2 to 3 times a week on average, 30 to 90 minutes each, by phone or Zoom, and more often in select weeks.
* Able to join by early or mid-November 2026. A notice period of 2 to 3 weeks or less.

**Nice to haves**

* You have worked directly with a US founder or US client in a company under 25 people.
* Agency background: you have run two or more client projects at the same time.
* Hands on paid search and paid social: you have run Google Ads or Meta campaigns yourself, or managed an agency that did, and reported cost per lead or cost per install.
* SEO for content and affiliate sites: keyword research, on page work, link audits, WordPress, affiliate network dashboards.
* Short form video: you have planned or produced Reels, Shorts or TikToks and read the retention and reach numbers afterward.
* Social scheduling and community tools: Meta Business Suite, Buffer, Hootsuite, Later or similar, and running WhatsApp or Facebook groups for a product audience.
* Product ownership of a consumer app or SaaS product: pricing tests, funnel and retention metrics, app store listings and reviews.
* Email marketing and marketing automation tools (Mailchimp, Aweber, HubSpot or similar).
* Exposure to outreach and CRM operations: LinkedIn, email sequences, Nimble, HubSpot or similar. One of our teams runs daily outreach for a US product.
* Release and hosting tooling: Google Play Console, App Store Connect, RevenueCat, Railway, Cloudflare, or close equivalents.
* Exposure to AI products or blockchain builds as a BA or PM.
* CSM, PSM, PMP or Google Ads certification. Useful, not required.

**Pay, location, schedule and reporting**

**Fixed pay**

₹7.0 to ₹8.0 lakh per year (₹58,000 to ₹67,000 per month), set on experience

**Performance bonus**

Up to 20% of fixed pay, tied to a combination of delivery goals and company performance and revenue goals agreed with the management team

**Total**

₹8.4 to ₹9.6 lakh per year

**Benefits**

Paid leave and statutory benefits per company policy; managed laptop and Microsoft 365 account

**Location**

MasterTech office, Thane West, Maharashtra. In office every working day

**Schedule**

Monday to Friday plus alternate Saturdays per the office calendar. Calls with the US based founder 2 to 3 times a week on average, 30 to 90 minutes, by phone or Zoom, more often in select weeks

**Reports to**

Founder and CEO (US based). Works with the office administrator on HR, attendance and finance matters

**Start:** November 2026

**Growth path:** MasterTech plans to grow over the next two years, in products, in client work and in headcount. This role will grow with it. The person who runs delivery well for a team of 10 is the person we want running it as the team gets bigger, and the scope of the role will widen as that happens.

Pay: ₹58,000.00 - ₹67,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Have you independently managed a web or mobile application project from requirements gathering to production release? Can you briefly describe one?
* How many team members have you directly managed, and what were their roles?
* Have you created Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), user stories, acceptance criteria, and test cases?
* What experience do you have with SEO, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, or paid advertising campaigns?
* How do you track project deadlines, resolve blockers, and communicate delivery delays to management or clients?

f9384496.title: Sr Technical Program Manager
f9384496.description:
**Life at Plume**

At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life's moments better. Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale.

We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We're expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data.

With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day.

**This is a work-from-office / In-Office role based in our Hyderabad, India location.**

**Job Summary**

Seeking an experienced, energetic and collaborative Engineering Program Manager to define and drive product success for our cloud based service platform.

They will be able to lead multiple simultaneous projects or programs that are complex and are able to develop recovery strategies for those that stray from their plan while being part of the collaborative, and fun loving team at a rapidly growing organization.

Plume develops and deploys cloud based control planes with scale to manage 10's of millions of customer homes through some of the world's largest ISPs. Plume cloud applications include WiFi network management and optimization, device access control, network provisioning and end customer user interaction through mobile apps. Our focus is on the home market and we support B2B and B2C product offerings.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, build and maintain the project plan including scope, schedule and risk management
* Drive execution and demonstrate end to end ownership of complex, technical programs to successful completion
* Drive deep collaboration across a network of critical dependencies
* Identify and resolve conflicts, inter-dependencies and program issues quickly and efficiently
* Lead cross functional project meetings and milestone reviews
* Deliver executive communication and drive the decision-making process
* Manage stakeholder and team communications and updates
* Develop roadmaps and development milestones for projects based on input from Product teams
* Monitor progress to plan and design a recovery strategy if project deviates from baseline plan

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) or relevant industry-standard experience, with 10+ years of experience.
* Experience working in rapidly growing organizations
* Must have strong technical background and Hands on experience in software development. Strong preference for candidate transitioned from lead development into Program Management
* Lead end-to-end program execution for initiatives such as feature development, interoperability, performance optimization, certification. working closely with firmware, driver, hardware, QA, and product teams to ensure timely and high-quality delivery.
* Must have prior experience working in the Wi-Fi domain and be able to understand and engage in technical discussions related to Wi-Fi protocols, features, performance issues, and firmware architecture. Ability to work closely with firmware teams on architecture, release planning, dependency management, defect triage, and risk mitigation is essential.
* Able to think strategically and tactically and to build consensus to make programs successful
* Demonstrable ability to think outside the box to resolve technical issues and resource conflicts
* Thorough knowledge of software engineering principles and agile methodologies
* 5+ years' experience managing fast-paced agile software projects with aggressive schedules
* Ability to quickly pick up new technologies and industry trends
* Outstanding critical thinking and problem-solving skills and passion to solve hard problems
* Excellent leadership and communication skills

**About Plume**

As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world's largest such as Charter, Liberty Global, and J:COM.

Using OpenSync, the most widely supported open-source, silicon-to-cloud framework for smart spaces, Plume's software-defined network allows ISPs to decouple their service offerings from hardware and rapidly curate and deliver new services over a multi-vendor, open-platform architecture.

Plume is an equal opportunity workplace that maintains a continuing policy of nondiscrimination in all employment practices and decisions, ensuring equal employment opportunities for all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy, childbirth or related individual conditions, medical conditions (as defined by state law), military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

25ce78ac.title: Senior Cloud DevOps Engineer
25ce78ac.description:
We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with deep expertise in backend application development and Microsoft Azure deployment engineering. The role will primarily own backend services, APIs, integrations, data access, application security, CI/CD, cloud hosting, observability, and production readiness. The ideal candidate will also have working exposure to AWS and/or Google Cloud Platform and enough frontend understanding to collaborate effectively with React and TypeScript engineers.

  

**1. Backend Engineering and API Ownership**

Develop and maintain scalable backend services using .NET, C#, and ASP.NET Core.
  
Build secure REST APIs, integrations, and core business logic.
  
Implement authentication and authorization using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and Microsoft Entra ID.
  
Design and optimize data models, repositories, and data access layers.
  
Develop resilient integrations with internal and external systems using secure and asynchronous patterns.

**2. Azure Deployment and Platform Engineering**

Design, deploy, and maintain cloud solutions on Microsoft Azure.
  
Build and manage services using Azure App Service, Functions, API Management, Storage, SQL, and Key Vault.
  
Develop CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions.
  
Implement monitoring, security, configuration management, and production readiness practices.
  
Contribute to containerization and Infrastructure as Code using Docker, Bicep, Terraform, or similar technologies.
  
Apply Azure best practices for security, scalability, reliability, and cost optimization.

**3. Multi-Cloud and Full Stack Collaboration**

Apply cloud architecture principles across Azure, AWS, and GCP.
  
Contribute to cloud deployment, security, and operational practices.
  
Collaborate with frontend teams to integrate backend services with React and TypeScript applications.
  
Support end-to-end application integration, troubleshooting, and AI-enabled solutions.

**4. Architecture, Quality, and Deliver**

Contribute to solution design, architecture, and technical estimations.
  
Develop high-quality, secure, and maintainable code following engineering best practices.
  
Perform code reviews and contribute to technical standards and reusable solutions.
  
Implement automated testing and support performance, security, and reliability.
  
Support end-to-end delivery, deployment, and production operations.

  

**Must Have Qualifications**  
6-8 years of software engineering experience with a strong backend focus.
  
Strong hands-on experience with C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, RESTful APIs, and backend design patterns.
  
Proven experience designing, deploying, and supporting applications on Microsoft Azure.
  
Strong understanding of CI/CD, infrastructure automation, observability, and application security.
  
Experience with Azure App Service, Functions, API Management, Storage, Azure SQL, Key Vault, and Entra ID.
  
Experience with Git, automated testing, containers, and agile engineering practices.
  
Working knowledge of React, TypeScript, JavaScript, and modern web application architecture.
  
Experience with microservices, messaging, asynchronous processing, and distributed system integration patterns.
  
Hands-on exposure to AWS and/or GCP services, deployment models, and operational practices.
  
Experience with Kubernetes or managed container platforms.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills**  
Experience implementing cloud architecture and deployment patterns across multiple cloud platforms.
  
Experience with event-driven architecture and serverless application development.
  
Exposure to AI-enabled applications, Azure AI services, LLM integrations, or Python-based services.
  
Experience building enterprise SaaS products or solutions for public-sector or regulated environments.
  
Exposure to GIS / geospatial features, map APIs, or document-driven platforms.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**  
The ideal candidate is a backend-oriented engineer with full-stack awareness who can independently own services, APIs, data, security, Azure deployments, and operational readiness. The candidate should be comfortable making sound technical decisions and collaborating closely with frontend, AI, cloud, and architecture teams. Azure expertise is the primary requirement; AWS and/or GCP exposure provides additional value and broader cloud perspective.

**BGV:**  
Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
  
Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

  

WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.

With approximately **4,000 talented people** across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than **73,000 globally** , in 550 **offices across 40 countries** , we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.

At “WSP” we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Uniﬁed under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones: **Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.**

**www.wsp.com**

**We are**

* Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future.
* A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking.
* A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues.

***Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose.***

**Working with Us**

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

**Our Hybrid Working Module**

With us, you can operate in a flexible, agile, yet structured work environment and follow a Hybrid Work Model.

* Maximize collaboration.
* Maintain product quality and cultural integrity.
Balance community, collaboration, opportunity, productivity, and efficiency.  

**Health, Safety and Wellbeing**

Our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize a safe work environment. Health, safety, and wellbeing are integral to our culture, with each of us accountable for fostering a safe workplace through our “Making Health and Safety Personal” initiative. Our Zero Harm Vision drives us to reduce risks through innovative solutions, earning recognition for our global health and safety practices with the prestigious RoSPA Health and Safety Awards for six consecutive years.

**Inclusivity and Diversity**

WSP India is dedicated to fostering a sustainable and inclusive work environment where our greatest strength - Our People -feel valued, respected, and supported. We ensure an unbiased approach in hiring, promotion, and performance evaluation, regardless of age, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, physical ability, education, social status, or cultural background.

**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**

Join our close-knit community of over 73,300 talented global professionals dedicated to making a positive impact. Together, we can make a difference in communities both near and far.

**With us, you can.**  
**Apply today.**

**NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:**

*WSP does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to WSP in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where WSP has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of WSP and WSP will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.*

edbf0cb4.title: Program Manager
edbf0cb4.description:
Manifest Global empowers in building companies that connect the world towards growth, prosperity, and innovation. Our portfolio includes trailblazer brands such as Cialfo, BridgeU, Explore, Kaaiser, EduGo, and Flow AI and which are dedicated to expanding global student mobility by serving their respective stakeholders in the ecosystem.
  
  
Our Mission
  
  
To create a world where every student, regardless of their ethnicity, nationality, socio-economic status, and learning preference, gets equal access to higher education through our world-class network of portfolio brands; a network that globally connects community stakeholders that provide the finest resources and support material, anywhere in the world and at any time.
  
  
What This Role Is
  
  
Every year, hundreds of thousands of students across India decide they want to study abroad. Some come through K12 school partnerships, some find their way in directly. Either way, they enter a journey - discovery, counseling, application, offer, enrollment - that runs through dozens of handoffs between people, platforms, and teams. When that journey works, a student ends up at a university that fits their budget, their course, and their ambitions, and the business realizes revenue at the moment they enroll. When it doesn't, applications stall, deadlines slip, and a student who could have enrolled goes quiet.
  
  
The problem is not that any single team is failing. It's that the highest-leverage work in a business like this doesn't live inside one function - it lives in the transformation and optimization projects that cut across Tech, Product, Marketing, and Operations, and someone needs to own them end to end. A funnel improvement that Marketing wants tested needs Product to build it and Tech to ship it. A new process that could remove a structural inefficiency needs someone to design it, prove it, and hand it off cleanly. Right now, that ownership happens informally, project by project, and the work that would compound doesn't get the sustained, disciplined execution it needs.
  
  
This is where this role sits. You will run multiple 'Strategize - Build - Operate - Transfer' projects a year - some of them genuinely 0-1 (new ideas that need user research, market research, and hypothesis testing before anyone knows if they work), some of them optimization projects on things that already exist but need better process design and a new benchmark for what good looks like. You will also be asked to take on whatever else is critical for the business to win, even when it doesn't have a job title yet.
  
  
You will own full-cycle delivery for these projects - from framing the problem with the right stakeholders, through build and testing, to launch, operating it long enough to prove it works, and transferring it cleanly to whoever owns it long-term. You are the person who makes sure a project doesn't just get discussed. It gets shipped, it gets proven, and it gets handed off in a state someone else can run with.
  
  
What Makes This Role Different
  
  
Most program management roles ask you to track a roadmap someone else designed. This one asks you to build the roadmap itself - deciding what the next transformation or optimization project should even be, then owning it across three or four functions that don't naturally report to the same person. The Strategize-Build-Operate-Transfer model means you don't hand a project off the moment it launches; you stay accountable until it's actually working and someone else can run it without you.
  
  
The Manifest ecosystem gives this role real range: some projects will be genuinely 0-1 - a new idea nobody has tested yet - and others will be 1-100 - scaling something that already works but is starting to strain under its own complexity. Few program roles at this stage give you exposure to both ends of that spectrum in the same year.
  
  
This is a build role, not a maintenance one. There is no finished playbook for how these projects should run - you're expected to design the frameworks, set the benchmarks, and prove through disciplined experimentation what should scale and what shouldn't.
  
  
What You Own
  
  
**Transformation projects (Strategize - Build - Operate - Transfer)**

* Translate a business problem into a project plan that Tech, Product, Marketing and Business teams can actually execute against
* Own the full lifecycle of assigned projects - scoping, stakeholder alignment, build, testing, launch, and post-launch review
* Own multiple SBOT-cycle projects a year, end to end, from initial strategy through a clean operational handoff
* Define what "operate" looks like well enough to prove a project works before transferring ownership
* Ensure nothing gets handed off half-finished - the transfer is only complete when the receiving team can run it without you

**0-1 initiatives**

* Lead user research, market research, and hypothesis testing on new ideas before committing resources to build them
* Design and run experiments that give a clear read on whether an idea is worth scaling
* Turn ambiguous, early-stage problems into a testable plan within weeks, not quarters

**Optimization and process design**

* Identify structural inefficiencies across the business and turn them into scoped optimization projects
* Build the frameworks and process designs that make a function run better, not just faster
* Set new benchmarks for what "good" looks like once a process has been redesigned

**Cross-functional execution and influence**

* Be the connective layer between Tech, Product, Marketing, and Operations so a project doesn't stall in the gap between roadmaps
* Lead cross-functional execution through credibility, influence, and clear decision-making rather than formal authority
* Take on whatever else is critical for the business to win, even without a predefined mandate

What Success Looks Like
  
  
The markers below reflect where Student Placements is today. We'll calibrate the specifics once you're in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.
  
  
In your first weeks, you're not shipping yet - you're building a working map of how projects actually move through Tech, Product, and Marketing today, and forming a point of view on where the highest-leverage transformation or optimization opportunities sit. You'll know you're on track when stakeholders start coming to you before a project stalls, not after.
  
  
By the middle of your first year, you've run at least one full SBOT cycle from strategy to clean handoff, and the people around you trust that if you've said something will happen, it will. You've proven, through real experiments rather than opinion, which 0-1 ideas are worth scaling and which aren't.
  
  
Longer term, the way the business runs cross-functional projects looks different because you built it that way - frameworks that outlast the specific projects they were built for, a track record of transformations that actually stuck, and a reputation as the person who gets called in when something critical and undefined needs to happen.
  
  
The specifics will be calibrated once you're in the role. The direction won't change.
  
  
What You Bring
  
  
You've spent five to eight years building things inside high-growth environments, and you've likely seen both ends of that growth curve - the 0-1 phase, where the job is rapid experimentation, hypothesis testing, and getting an MVP in front of real users, and the 1-100 phase, where the job becomes process design and managing the complexity that scale creates. You know which mode a problem calls for and you don't try to apply 1-100 rigor to a 0-1 problem, or vice versa.
  
  
You have real comfort operating in ambiguity, and more than that, you're fast at moving from ambiguity to clarity - you ask the right question early, you don't wait for someone to hand you a clean brief, and you get to a workable answer quickly rather than a perfect one slowly.
  
  
You think in first principles. When a process is broken, you don't default to the existing framework - you rebuild the logic from the ground up and design something better, then prove it works before asking anyone to trust it.
  
  
Most importantly, you read the description of what this role is building and your first reaction was not "this sounds like a coordination job." It was "this is exactly the kind of ambiguous, high-leverage problem I want to be handed." That's the person this role is for.
  
  
Why Manifest
  
  
Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility - connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 50+ countries. Our portfolio spans Cialfo (AI-powered college counseling, 2,000+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI-powered university outreach, 1,000+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. 85M workers will be missing from developed economies by 2030. We're building the operating system which changes that. $80M raised. Still early.
  
  
Student Placements is where that infrastructure meets an individual student's decision - and the transformation and optimization work this role owns is what makes that infrastructure work better at every scale it operates at.
  
  
Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, operating across 50+ countries.

4e53becf.title: Presales Consultant- MWS
4e53becf.description:
Job Purpose
  
  
Working closely with the Sales Team, the Presales Consultant – MWS is responsible for providing presales technical support, solution consulting, and product demonstrations for Modern Workplace Solutions. The role involves understanding customer business requirements, identifying suitable technology solutions, and presenting tailored demonstrations and solution proposals to customers and business partners.
  
  
The Presales Consultant will support the Sales Team in qualifying opportunities, developing technical solutions, expanding existing customer engagements, and driving customer adoption of MWS products and solutions. The role will also involve conducting technical proof of concepts (POCs), demonstrations, presentations, and technical validation activities to showcase the value and capabilities of supported products and solutions.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  

* Assist Account Managers and Product Managers in qualifying sales opportunities by providing technical expertise and solution recommendations for Modern Workplace Solutions.
* Provide presales technical support and deliver in-depth product demonstrations to customers, prospects, and business partners.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend appropriate solutions across endpoint devices, workplace productivity, collaboration, endpoint management, and security, based on the supported product portfolio.
* Conduct customer presentations, technical workshops, solution briefings, and demonstrations to highlight product features, benefits, and business value.
* Coordinate and manage technical proof of concepts (POCs), product evaluations, and solution validation activities.
* Support the development of technical proposals, solution designs, and responses to Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and Requests for Information (RFIs).
* Enable and train channel partners on MWS products, solutions, use cases, and key technical differentiators.
* Collaborate with Sales, vendors, distributors, and technical teams to develop customer-specific solutions and address technical queries.
* Support opportunity qualification through technical discovery, requirement gathering, and solution-fit assessments.
* Manage and coordinate demonstration equipment, POC assets, and other technical resources required for customer engagements.
* Stay updated on emerging workplace technologies, product enhancements, industry trends, and competitor offerings.
* Recommend relevant market content, technical presentations, and sales enablement materials to support business development.
* Participate in customer events, partner meets, conferences, exhibitions, and product launches as required.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills and Experience
  
  

* Good understanding of Modern Workplace Solutions, including end-user computing, workplace productivity, collaboration, endpoint management, and endpoint security technologies.
* Familiarity with enterprise workplace solutions such as laptops, desktops, workstations, accessories, unified communications, and collaboration tools, depending on the supported portfolio.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365, Microsoft Intune, Windows operating systems, endpoint deployment, device management, and identity and access management would be an advantage.
* Understanding of endpoint security, device compliance, data protection, and secure workplace practices.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and translate business needs into appropriate technical solutions.
* Experience in presales consulting, product demonstrations, technical presentations, POCs, or solution validation is preferred.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in simple business terms.
* Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and provide effective solutions during customer engagements.
* Strong customer-facing skills and the ability to build relationships with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.
* Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable working in a dynamic, target-driven environment.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and handle a high volume of requests, including unplanned customer and sales requirements.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and interact effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

**About Cognizant Consulting**
Cognizant Consulting is more than Cognizant’s consulting practice, we’re a global community of 5,000+ experts dedicated to helping clients reimagine their business. Blending our deep industry and technology advisory capability, we create innovative business solutions for Fortune 500 clients. And now, we’re looking for our next colleague who’ll join us in shaping the future of business. Could it be you?
  
  
**About The Role**
As a CIS Presales Solution Manager, you will make an impact by shaping and driving differentiated infrastructure solutions across Managed Services and Digital Transformation opportunities for clients in every vertical. You will be a valued member of the Cloud, Infrastructure and Security (CIS) Services Solution Group team and work collaboratively with onsite sales, solutions and delivery teams, and clients.
  
  
**In this role, you will**

* Take end-to-end responsibility for solution and commercial creation and integration, including conducting scoping workshops, questionnaires and solution discussions.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to design winnable, differentiated solutions that meet customer requirements.
* Lead solution workshops, MVD/CAS sessions, due diligence and pursuit-related workshops, interfacing with clients and third-party advisors (TPAs).
* Develop winning themes, SWOT and competitor analysis, and build re-usable bid components, templates and frameworks for strategic pursuit management.
* Manage and mentor a team of junior and mid-level solution managers.

**Work model**
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Chennai or Bangalore. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  
**What You Must Have To Be Considered**

* Strong techno-commercial capability with proven customer interaction and solution presentation skills.
* Solid IT infrastructure technical understanding across Compute (on-prem and cloud), Network, Security, End User and Service Management, including Managed Services and Digital Transformation.
* Knowledge of service assurance and automation tools and ITIL/ITSM processes.
* Knowledge of pricing models, IT spend analysis, business case development, and TCO and ROI analysis.
* A proven track record in fast-paced environments with strong, complex problem-solving skills and the ability to see problems through to resolution.

**These will help you succeed**

* Awareness of industry IT trends and analyst/TPA reports such as Gartner, Everest, Forrester, ISG, BCG, HfS and IDC.
* Experience in cross-cultural settings and with top-tier outsourcing organizations.
* Excellent communication, presentation and analytical skills with a proactive, can-do attitude.
* Ability to shape creative, innovative solutions deliverable at acceptable business profit levels, with effective project and time management.
* Flexibility and mobility to accommodate short domestic and international business travel (up to 2 months).

Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

Be part of a supportive environment that fosters growth, teamwork, and meaningful contributions to Cisco’s success.

You will collaborate closely with the account team and connected sales teams to ensure customer success, serving as a trusted technical advisor.
  
  

* Leverage deep knowledge of Cisco’s portfolio, including specialized and architectural perspectives. Drive penetration through cross-selling and up-selling while displacing competition. Be responsible for the technical relationship with customers and partners.
* Lead engagements with IT and business decision-makers, understand customer environments and market dynamics, and translate business needs into technical requirements.
* Focus on landing opportunities and expanding within accounts. Participate actively in customer strategic planning.
* Provide valuable feedback to Business Executives and sales teams on strategic customer needs, market opportunities, and competitive tactics.
* Lead deals through the technical sales process, design and present solutions based on customer requirements, manage virtual sales support teams, and leverage tools to support deals.
* Increase revenue by converting opportunities to closed deals, displace competitors to grow market share, and expand the customer base quarterly.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop multi-year strategic plans integrating Cisco’s portfolio for customers.
* Deepen expertise by combining domain knowledge with cross-architectural solutions.
* Shape technical strategies for senior executives.
* Align customer business objectives with industry knowledge to create comprehensive solutions.
* Lead demand generation and enablement initiatives.
* Identify latent customer needs and showcase cross-architecture solutions.
* Lead impactful demonstrations emphasizing business outcomes driven by Cisco solutions.
* Use competitive intelligence to differentiate Cisco offerings.
* Mobilize broad stakeholder networks to drive transformative synergies and optimize relationships.
* Direct virtual and extended sales teams toward continuous improvement and oversee educational programs.
* Demonstrate agility by adapting strategies in response to market disruptions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree with 8+ years of related experience, or an advanced degree (Master's or PhD) with related experience.
* Proficiency in Cisco networking technologies and solutions, including SD-WAN, MPLS, LAN, Cloud, Unified Communications (UC), and Security.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong understanding of cloud computing platforms and services.
* Expertise in Cisco’s cloud portfolio to design scalable, secure, and cost-effective architectures.
* Hands-on experience with network automation tools to streamline deployment, management, and operational efficiency of network and collaboration solutions.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

**Placement and employer development (core)**

* Use LinkedIn and other social platforms to identify and reach potential clients, hiring companies, HR heads and technology leaders.

The Manufacturing Solutions Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing manufacturing processes to ensure efficient production and high-quality products. A **Process Owner – Sheet Metal & CAD/CAM** manages the end-to-end fabrication workflow, standardizes manufacturing methods, and optimizes CNC programming for cutting, punching, and bending operations.

**Job Overview**

* **Role:** Process Owner (Sheet Metal Fabrication Industry & CAD/CAM)

**What will you be doing?**

* **Process Ownership:** Design, implement, and govern end-to-end sheet metal processes from raw material handling to final bent/assembled parts.

* **Quality & Troubleshooting:** Resolve shop-floor bottlenecks, dimensional deviations, and tooling issues.
* **Standardization:** Develop standard operating procedures (SOPs), setup sheets, and work instructions for production teams.

* Career progression and opportunities within a global organization

Employee engagement is a key focus area for us and we encourage participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is an integral part of our culture and the daily practice. We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized. In being a great place to work, we are proud to offer a range of experiences and opportunities that will help you to achieve your career and personal goals and enable you to live a healthy and balanced life.*

Siemens Mobility is an independent handled company of Siemens AG. Its core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems, intelligent road traffic technology and related services. The Information Technology (IT) department has the global responsibility for the internal IT of Siemens Mobility. Its goal is to provide a robust and efficient IT landscape derived from business and market demands. Your personality and individuality make the difference. In our team, we increase business performance and point the way into the digital age. Is that exactly your thing? Then live your passion in a cross-location team in which you can actively craft the future of our company. You open up new possibilities for our customers with your competence. Connected with this is an exciting career path that leads you to ever new projects and solutions in the field of IT for Siemens Mobility.

**We are looking for an Enterprise Architect**

**You’ll make a difference by:**

As member of our global Enterprise Architecture team at SMO IT you play an important role in digital transition and establishing the enterprise function in our company as enabling partner for our business to achieve business goals and position IT as enabler.

* As part of a global team, you will be responsible for enterprise architecture management (including business IT alignment and analysis of the application portfolio) and derive IT strategies from business requirements.
* Lead IT transformation programs passionate about optimizing the application portfolio to support business objectives and improve operational efficiency.
* Ensure interoperability of different applications within the enterprise according to modern integration pattern and domain driven design.
* Provide architectural guidance and governance for new solutions, services and ensure their compliance with the existing architectural landscape.
* Define intentional architecture as a purposeful set of statements, models, and decisions that represent some future architectural state, and derive the roadmap to achieve this state.
* Shape the target operation model on cloud infrastructures together with the cloud competence center
* Apply and contribute to governance frameworks that ensure compliance, security, and alignment with enterprise architecture principles.
* Engage with key collaborators to establish IT as enabler and partner for value proposition, and ensure that enterprise architecture initiatives meet business needs.
* Shift from experience-based to fact-based decision-making by the means of the enterprise repository

**You’ll win us over by:**

* Bachelor/master’s degree or equivalent experience in computer science or comparable education with corresponding additional skills
* Proven experience in enterprise architecture, with a focus on IT transformation programs in enterprise context
* Proven skills in the field of Enterprise Architecture Management, relevant certifications (e.g., TOGAF, PMP) is a plus.
* Experience with LeanIX for EAM is a plus
* Sound knowledge from anyone or more aspect of Business Architecture, Application Architecture, Data Architecture, Technology Architecture.
* Experience in architecture design and modeling
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to actively engage and influence senior leadership and key collaborators.
* Experience in leading IT projects, including budget management and resource allocation with the ability to align IT initiatives with business objectives.
* Ability to lead multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, and adapt to changing business needs.
* Understand the business & technical architecture concepts for sophisticated IT architectures.
* Knowledge in IT governance, risk management, and emerging technologies; familiarity with application portfolio management tools and techniques is a plus.
* Experiences in one of our technology domains: IoT, AI, Cloud native ideally in combination with domain expertise in logistics, manufacturing or other subject areas in railways industries

**Join us and be yourself!**

We value your outstanding identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and build a better tomorrow with us.

**Make your mark in our exciting world at Siemens.**

This role is based in Pune and is an Individual contributor role. You might be required to visit other locations within India and outside. In return, you'll get the chance to work with teams impacting - and the shape of things to come. We're Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and inspiration and help us shape tomorrow.

Find out more about Siemens careers at: www.siemens.com/careers & more about mobility at https://new.siemens.com/global/en/products/mobility.html

f3b9d3d8.title: Data & AI Architect
f3b9d3d8.description:
**About the Role:**

We are looking for an experienced Data & AI Architect to define and govern the target architecture for Advanced Analytics, AI, and Data Products across SVD TEC. As the Data & AI Architect, you will ensure that analytics and AI initiatives are built on a scalable, secure, reusable, and governed foundation rather than isolated project-specific solutions.

You will define architecture standards, integration patterns, data contracts, AI deployment approaches, and governance models that enable teams to consistently deliver analytics and AI capabilities across products such as EMS, O4O, EcoMAIN, OBS AI, condition monitoring, and predictive maintenance. You will act as the technical authority connecting business needs, product strategy, data platforms, AI services, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, and product teams.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Define and maintain the target Data & AI Architecture for SVD TEC.
* Establish standards for data ingestion, storage, processing, analytics, AI, and interoperability.
* Design reusable architecture building blocks and reference patterns.
* Define architecture principles for Data Products, Data Governance, Data Quality, Analytics Platforms, MLOps, AI Platforms, Agent Architectures, Knowledge Graphs, GraphRAG, and Integration Services.
* Drive architectural alignment across SDA, EMS, O4O, EcoMAIN, OBS AI, and future initiatives.
* Define integration approaches between internal platforms, customer environments, industrial systems, cloud services, and AI capabilities.
* Establish data contracts, API standards, interoperability guidelines, and reusable integration patterns.
* Participate in technology evaluations and partner assessments.
* Review and approve architectural decisions for major AI and analytics initiatives.
* Support cybersecurity, compliance, and governance reviews.
* Define transition strategies from PoC to MVP to production.
* Coach engineers and project teams on architecture best practices.
* Identify technical risks, bottlenecks, and architectural debt early.

**Mandatory Requirements:**

* Strong experience as Solution Architect, Enterprise Architect, Data Architect, Analytics Architect, or AI Architect.
* Deep understanding of modern data architectures and analytics platforms.
* Experience designing enterprise-scale data ecosystems.
* Strong understanding of Data Lakehouse architectures, Data Warehousing, Data Mesh, Data Products, Data Governance, Metadata, Data Catalogs, Event-driven architectures, API architectures, and Cloud-native architectures.
* Experience with AI deployment architectures, MLOps, and operationalization of models.
* Ability to communicate architecture decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience balancing long-term architecture goals with delivery realities.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Skills & Attributes:**

* Experience with Microsoft Azure, Foundry, Fabric, Cognite Data Fusion, or equivalent platforms.
* Experience with industrial data platforms, time-series data, asset models, historian systems, and IoT architectures.
* Hands-on experience with Knowledge Graphs, Semantic Layers, GraphRAG, Agentic AI Architectures, Multi-Agent Systems, Vector Databases, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation.
* Understanding of cybersecurity, identity management, confidential data handling, and regulatory requirements.
* Excellent systems thinking and ability to identify architectural dependencies across products and teams.
* Pragmatic mindset that prioritizes business value while maintaining architectural integrity.

**About the Team:**

Join the Advanced Analytics team responsible for establishing the long-term Data & AI foundation across SVD TEC. This role will shape how analytics, AI, digital products, and industrial data platforms evolve over the coming years. You will ensure that innovations in condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, AI assistants, analytics products, and agentic AI are built on a common architecture that is scalable, maintainable, secure, and reusable across the portfolio.

Siemens Energy India Limited (SEIL) has been a strategic partner in India for more than 100 years and is focused on being the most-valued energy technology company. Our large footprint spread across the entire region (India, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Nepal, Maldives) with state-of-the-art facilities and customers installations positively impacts the lives of hundreds of millions of people, helping the countries navigate their energy transition and achieve its net zero targets.

SEIL is a pure play energy technology company, oﬀering a comprehensive portfolio of products, solutions, and services designed to support our customers along the entire energy value chain to go through their energy transition journey and achieve their net zero targets. Our portfolio oﬀering includes low to zero emissions power generation, power transmission and storage, and decarbonization of the industry. More information on: www.siemens-energy-india.com

8826da9e.title: Solution Architect
8826da9e.description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators who are focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

  

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

  

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies that rely on our best-in-class platform.

  

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals and we have fun celebrating
our wins.

  

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and be your best self!

At Anaplan these words come to life by making employees feel empowered and inspired.
  
Building a strong culture around company values is an ongoing journey that will continue to be the core of our existence.

  

We want you to think big and act bold through expressing your authentic best self! Anaplan is looking for a tenacious
**SENIOR SOLUTION ARCHITECT**
 to join 
**PROFESSIONAL SERVICES**
in
**INDIA.**
This is a stellar opportunity to get involved in a highly visible, large scale SaaS cloud company. This role is an immediate full-time position. If you’re ready to roll up your sleeves and seek unique problems that no one else is solving, keep reading.

  

**Come see for yourself what an exciting place to work looks like**

  

**Insight on your impact**

  

We're not looking for average.  Do you enjoy diving into issues and designing complex solutions?  Do you have a passion for data, multi-dimensional modeling and data integration? If so, this job is for you.

  

**What you'll be doing:**

  

As an Anaplan Solution architect, you are primarily responsible for architect, design and the successful delivery of Anaplan planning solutions in strategic accounts. You will:

  

  
* Understand, review and gather client requirements per Anaplan defined scoping & analysis
  
* Translate existing solutions, spreadsheets, and business problems into sophisticated Anaplan multi-dimensional models
  
* Modify existing models as part of a connected solution, optimization, or to incorporate new functionality
  
* Serve as the architectural SME for large-scale connected planning solutions
  
* Exemplify The Anaplan Way
  
* Provide candid, meaningful feedback and progress updates in a timely manner to the Project Manager/Business Partner and team
  
* Develop Anaplan model documentation
  
* Participate and/or lead Data Integration and Migration Solutions
  
* Participate and/or lead UAT testing and deployment
  

  

**Your qualifications, your influence**

  

*To be successful in the role, you must possess the following skills*

  

  
* A 6 year degree in Finance, Accounting or Supply chain experience
  
* 4+ years’ experience implementing Enterprise Performance Management solutions or 4+ years experience in Data and Analytics
  
* 4+ years experience in either of following functional areas : Financial Planning & Analysis or Sales Performance Management
  
* Sophisticated Microsoft Excel / financial modeling skills
  
* Proven knowledge of a formal system implementation methodology – requirements gathering, design, build/test and deploy (Agile methodology preferable)
  
* Superb written and oral communication skills
  
* Proven track record to lead execute responsibilities simultaneously
  
* Appetite for service excellence and a collaborative style
  
* **Subject matter expertise in planning and modeling in Supply Chain strongly preferred**
  
* Strong understanding of data integration (inbound and outbound)
  
* Passion for business analytics, modeling and planning
  
* Excellent problem solving and analytical skills
  
* Results-oriented, motivated, self-starter
  
* Coaching mentality
  
* Collegial, open and grounded in integrity
  
* Desire to work with a truly dynamic and exciting team, with a “roll-up your sleeves” approach
  
* Strong desire to excel and be committed to gaining exposure to multiple industries while further developing your career
  

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion**

**and Belonging**

  

Build your career in a place that thrives on diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

  

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

  

**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**

  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

  

Anaplan does not:

  

  
* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
  
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible, and then followed up via written communication.
  

  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.
