efcf372d.title: Storage & Backup Architect
efcf372d.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

We are looking for an experienced Storage & Backup Architect to design, implement, manage, and optimize enterprise storage, backup, and disaster recovery infrastructure. The candidate should have strong expertise in SAN/NAS technologies, enterprise backup solutions, data protection, replication, recovery planning, capacity management, and performance optimization across large-scale data center environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise storage and backup architectures aligned with business continuity, performance, scalability, and availability requirements.

* Architect and manage SAN, NAS, block, file, and object storage solutions.
* Configure and manage Fibre Channel, iSCSI, NFS, SMB, RAID, LUN provisioning, zoning, and multipathing.
* Design and implement enterprise backup, recovery, archival, and data retention solutions.
* Manage backup policies, schedules, retention, replication, and recovery procedures for physical and virtual environments.
* Implement backup solutions for VMware, Windows, Linux, databases, applications, and file systems.
* Design and manage backup infrastructure, including backup servers, media servers, repositories, deduplication appliances, and backup storage.
* Implement and manage immutable backups, air-gapped protection, and ransomware recovery strategies.
* Design and validate disaster recovery solutions, including storage replication, backup copies, recovery objectives (RPO/RTO), and DR testing.
* Monitor backup job status, resolve failures, troubleshoot performance issues, and ensure successful backup and restore operations.
* Perform periodic recovery testing and validate data integrity and recoverability.
* Manage storage capacity planning, performance monitoring, utilization, and lifecycle management.
* Lead storage and backup migrations, upgrades, refresh activities, and infrastructure transformation projects.
* Integrate storage and backup solutions with VMware, enterprise servers, databases, and data center infrastructure.
* Prepare HLDs, LLDs, implementation plans, SOPs, backup policies, and disaster recovery documentation.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, network, virtualization, application, and security teams to resolve complex technical issues.
* Provide technical leadership for incident management, root cause analysis, and infrastructure optimization.

### **Requirements**

**Required Technical Skills**
-----------------------------

* Strong expertise in enterprise storage architecture, administration, and troubleshooting.

* Hands-on experience with SAN/NAS, Fibre Channel, iSCSI, RAID, storage provisioning, and multipathing.
* Experience with enterprise storage platforms such as Dell PowerStore/PowerMax, NetApp, HPE Alletra/Primera, IBM FlashSystem, or equivalent.
* Strong experience with enterprise backup solutions such as Veeam, Veritas NetBackup, Dell NetWorker, Commvault, or equivalent.
* Knowledge of backup architecture, backup repositories, deduplication, compression, replication, and retention management.
* Experience in backup and recovery for VMware virtual machines, Windows/Linux servers, databases, and enterprise applications.
* Understanding of immutable backups, ransomware protection, off-site backup copies, and air-gapped recovery.
* Expertise in disaster recovery planning, RPO/RTO requirements, recovery testing, and business continuity.
* Experience with storage replication, snapshots, thin provisioning, and data migration.
* Knowledge of VMware vSphere integration with storage and backup infrastructure.
* Experience in performance monitoring, capacity planning, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.
* Ability to create technical architecture documents, implementation plans, and operational procedures.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

* Relevant storage or backup vendor certifications are an advantage.
* Experience working in large enterprise, telecom, or service-provider data center environments.
* Exposure to automation, monitoring, and infrastructure management tools.

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

* Excellent communication and technical documentation skills.
* Ability to lead technical discussions and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
* Strong focus on data protection, service availability, security, and operational excellence

**Expected Outcome**
--------------------

Deliver a secure, scalable, and resilient storage and backup infrastructure that ensures data availability, reliable backup and recovery, disaster recovery readiness, and business continuity across enterprise IT environments.

**Working Hours**

Monday to Saturday (6 Days)

### **Benefits**

9e7a1662.title: Global Cybersecurity Senior Manager - Architecture
9e7a1662.description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

As the Infrastructure Security Architect – Secure Data, you will serve as the dedicated security architecture partner for BCG’s Secure Data Engineering Squad, owning the cyber defense governance and technical protection requirements for data security architecture covering data loss prevention, classification enforcement, encryption, and secrets management.

The role operates under the shared accountability model between ISRM Security Architecture and Secure Infrastructure Engineering: ISRM defines how platforms are secured and governed through security standards and architecture strategy; Platform Engineering owns the physical and logical implementation, delivery, and operation of those platforms.

You will ensure the Secure Data portfolio aligns with BCG’s Global Information Security Policy (GISP), the Cybersecurity Control Framework (CSF-10 (Data Protection)), the Security Architecture Reference Model, and the CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model (Data pillar), embedding security from design through delivery while preserving control integrity and audit defensibility.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and maintain data security architecture: data loss prevention (DLP), data classification and tagging enforcement, encryption, and data privacy governance interfaces.
* Own architectural requirements for Microsoft Purview enforcement: sensitivity labeling, auto-labeling policy design, DLP policy architecture across endpoints, email, and cloud services.
* Define data classification enforcement architecture in alignment with the Global Data Classification Policy and Global Data Protection Policy, ensuring controls scale with data sensitivity.
* Own encryption and key management architecture requirements for infrastructure-managed data, including interfaces to secrets management and enterprise key management platforms including crypto-agility and post-quantum cryptography (PQC) migration readiness for infrastructure-managed data and key material.
* Define secure data access patterns for infrastructure-managed data stores and application interfaces, preventing unauthorized access, exposure, or tampering.
* Architect DLP coverage for emerging data egress channels, including AI-enabled tooling and agentic workflows, in coordination with Enterprise Security Architecture.
* Author and maintain the security standards, reference architectures, and control requirements that govern the Secure Data domain, mapped to CSF-10 (Data Protection) and ZTMM maturity targets.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for secure data initiatives; issue dispositions, conditions, and architectural decision records traceable to ISRM governance.
* Contribute domain expertise to ZTMM maturity assessments, control gap analyses, and the security architecture roadmap.
* Serve as the dedicated architecture counterpart to the Secure Data Engineering Squad, validating feasibility and effectiveness of security controls through implementation without assuming delivery ownership.
* Define logging, telemetry, and monitoring requirements (CSF-12) for secure data services in partnership with Security Operations, which owns SIEM, detection engineering, and continuous monitoring

What You'll Bring

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.

* 6–10 years in security architecture, security engineering, or infrastructure security with demonstrated architecture responsibility.

* Experience operating in large, audit-sensitive, or regulated enterprise environments with formal governance and exception processes.

* Strong understanding of zero trust architecture (NIST SP 800-207, CISA ZTMM), enterprise control frameworks, and hybrid cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).

* Deep hands-on architecture experience with Microsoft Purview (Information Protection, DLP), enterprise data classification programs, and encryption architecture.

* Working knowledge of key management and secrets management platforms (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, cloud-native KMS/HSM), BYOK patterns, and cryptographic standards lifecycle.

* Familiarity with insider risk, data egress monitoring, and DLP enforcement across endpoint, network, and SaaS channels.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Professional certifications such as CISSP, SABSA, or relevant cloud security certifications.

Who You'll Work With

You will join the Infrastructure Security Architecture team within Information Security Risk Management (ISRM), serving as the dedicated security architecture partner for BCG’s Secure Data Engineering Squad. In this role, you will own the governance and technical architecture requirements that protect data across loss prevention, classification enforcement, encryption, and secrets management.

You will collaborate closely with engineering, cloud, identity, infrastructure, and security teams across BCG’s global technology organization to ensure data security controls are consistently designed, implemented, and governed. You will also partner with Security Operations, Risk Management, and architecture peers to advance Zero Trust Data pillar maturity and support enterprise-wide cybersecurity initiatives.

Working within a highly collaborative, matrixed environment, you will influence technical direction, build alignment on architectural decisions, and help teams deliver secure, scalable solutions that balance business objectives, operational effectiveness, and risk management.

Additional info

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

**You’re Good At**

* Translating enterprise security standards into practical, implementable engineering requirements.

* Holding architecture authority constructively: enabling delivery teams rather than blocking them, while keeping governance boundaries intact.

* Communicating precisely across engineering squads, architecture peers, and senior security leadership.

Regular, Full-Time (local employment terms apply)

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

****Who we are****

Born in 2014, Yoti is a digital identity and biometric technology company that makes it safer for people to prove who they are. The Yoti app was designed with privacy at its core, giving people a secure way to prove their identity and share third-party credentials with organisations and other people.

Today, we have over twenty million app downloads around the world. We’ve expanded our offering to a suite of business solutions that span identity verification, age verification and estimation, e-signing, AI anti-spoofing technologies and we continue to think of innovative new offerings. 

From day one, we’ve been working to fix an outdated identity system. This is not a journey we make on our own but with policy advisors, think tanks, researchers, academics, humanitarian bodies, our users and everyday people. We are committed to solving identity problems through grassroots research and social purpose initiatives. Our dedication to our mission and our team is why Yoti was proudly named one of the Sunday Times Best Places to Work 2026 in the UK. 

****Purpose of the Role:****

Serve as the main technical contact for Level 2 client support and lead improvements in Yoti’s support processes. Own and maintain public developer documentation to ensure seamless integrations for clients and partners.

****Role Dimensions:****

Member of the Solutions team within Client Services, working closely with Product, Customer Support, BI (Business Intelligence), and Operations.

****Principal Responsibilities:****

* Lead and manage Level 2 client support channels, resolving technical integration queries and complex support cases for Yoti’s products and services.
* Analyse support trends to identify and implement process improvements, reducing repetitive queries and driving efficiency.
* Proactively build and maintain expertise in Yoti’s APIs, and web and mobile SDKs.

* Strong knowledge of web technologies (JavaScript, REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhooks) and backend concepts; containerization (Docker) is a bonus.

* Demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues for external clients, particularly in Level 2 support and escalations.
* Experience writing and maintaining high-quality technical documentation and architecture diagrams.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills; able to convey technical topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Analytical thinker with strong problem-solving skills; proactive and detail-focused.
* Collaborative and effective team player, able to work cross-functionally and support a culture of shared learning.
* Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field (e.g. Computer Science, Information Technology) or equivalent hands-on experience.

****Interview Process****

Stage 1 - Call with a Talent acquisition Team member (30 minutes)

Stage 2 - Call with Head of Solutions (45 minutes)

Stage 3 - Activity/Presentation

Stage 4 - Call with Head of Solutions and Director of Client services (60 minutes)

****What’s in it for you?****

* Performance based discretionary annual bonus
* LTIP (Long term incentive plan)
* Medical Insurance cover of INR 5 lakhs
* Life Insurance / Accidental cover
* Gratuity as per law

This is a great opportunity to join a company that is leading the way for innovative and responsible identity verification. We’re looking for people who can adapt to a fast-paced environment, as well as champion our brand and what we stand for. ddcfe592.title: Digital Solutions Engineer
ddcfe592.description:
**Job Description: Digital Solutions Engineer**

  

**About Lilly**

*At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work but it's work worth doing. If you're driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.*

  

**Manufacturing & Quality Technical Hub, Hyderabad**

*Lilly's Hyderabad hub is a first-of-its-kind technical center built to lead the manufacturing and quality science agenda for Lilly's global supply network, and the work done here reaches patients in more than 110 countries.*

*This hub oversees contract manufacturing of starting materials and intermediates for API manufacturing in India, managing the full scientific agenda for manufacturing and quality. We're building a cutting-edge scientific organization and looking for top talent in process engineering, chemistry, analytical and data sciences to be part of it.*

*The science you develop here doesn't stay here. It moves through Lilly's global supply network and reaches patients across more than 110 countries who are counting on it.*

Digital Manufacturing Engineering (DME) is part of the Corporate Engineering Tech Center (ETC). The ETC is a technical resource for training, standards, project implementation, and the center of engineering excellence for the corporation, providing deeply technical resources to solve the most intractable technical problems in manufacturing. DME provides Digital Engineering Platform ownership, OT data integration solutions, engineering data standardization/ownership, and digital manufacturing solutions for Lilly Manufacturing. Our team focuses on connecting our facilities (securely) and leveraging the data from those facilities to deliver digital manufacturing solutions to improve manufacturing productivity, data integrity / compliance, quality, and operational excellence. Digital Manufacturing Technologies include digital twins, computational modeling, edge/IoT, and analytics solutions. Digital Engineering Platforms include CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System), GECMS (Global Engineering Content Management System) and many other digital platforms leveraged by engineers across Lilly Manufacturing.

  

**Position Description and Responsibilities**

The Principal Digital Solutions Engineer will design, develop, support, and continuously enhance digital solutions across Lilly's global manufacturing network, while serving as the owner for one or more digital products developed by the DME team. Representative solutions in scope span the four pillars of the Engineering Digital Strategy and include but are not limited to the Intralogistics Monitor (ILM), Audit Trail solutions, Condition-Based Maintenance solutions, RCA and troubleshooting solutions, equipment health and predictive maintenance dashboards, capital project and qualification workflow tools, engineering knowledge search, and inspection-readiness data products. These solutions are developed on standard Digital Engineering Platforms supported by the DME team, and the engineer will partner with data leads to ensure the necessary IT, OT, and ET data is available to support each solution. The engineer is also expected to leverage AI tools and platforms such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, and Anthropic's Claude to accelerate development and to embed AI capability into solutions, including building agent skills, prompt-based workflows, and retrieval/automation patterns on top of existing Lilly-approved AI platforms. This role is not focused on training or developing foundation models; it is focused on applying AI tools effectively and responsibly to manufacturing problems. This is a global role, supporting functional initiatives and all Lilly Manufacturing sites globally.

This role operates within an evolved Digital Solutions Engineering operating model. The team includes a Rapid Innovation branch that works at speed to prototype concepts and proof-of-value solutions against key business problems surfaced from the manufacturing network. The Principal Digital Solutions Engineer takes ownership of those solutions once they have been validated as worth scaling — maturing them from prototype to production-grade, hardening them for validated-system and data-integrity requirements, deploying and supporting them across sites, and providing long-term ownership over their roadmap, enhancement, and lifecycle. This split lets the Rapid Innovation branch stay focused on speed and discovery while the Principal Digital Solutions Engineer ensures that the most valuable concepts become durable, well-supported solutions that scale across the global manufacturing network.

The primary focus of the role is twofold. First, to develop and continuously enhance high-quality digital solutions that deliver measurable value to manufacturing operations — improving productivity, data integrity and compliance, quality, and operational excellence. Second, to assume the role of owner for those solutions: defining the product roadmap, managing the backlog, owning the technical architecture and lifecycle, ensuring compliance with validated-system requirements, and providing direct technical support to global users across Lilly Manufacturing. The engineer will work under guidance of the Digital Program Lead and partner closely with site engineers, network engineering organizations, and IT/OT platform owners to ensure each solution remains fit-for-purpose as the network and the underlying technology landscape evolve.

  

**Key Objectives/Deliverables**

* Develop and continuously enhance digital solutions in support of the Engineering Digital Strategy for Manufacturing and Quality across its four pillars: Asset Delivery & Qualification, Asset Performance/Maintenance & Reliability, Engineering Fundamentals, and Training & Knowledge Management.
* Build and own solutions across a broad portfolio that may include: the Intralogistics Monitor (ILM), Audit Trail solutions, Condition-Based Maintenance solutions, equipment health and predictive maintenance dashboards, RCA and troubleshooting tools, capital project and equipment qualification workflow tools, engineering knowledge search, change-management assistants, and inspection-readiness data products.
* Serve as owner for one or more DME-developed digital products, including ownership of the product roadmap, backlog, technical architecture, and full lifecycle from build through sustained operation.
* Partner with the Rapid Innovation branch of the Digital Solutions Engineering team to take in validated prototypes and proof-of-value solutions, then mature them into production-grade, validated, scalable solutions ready for global deployment.
* Lead the deployment of solutions across Lilly Manufacturing sites — including site onboarding, configuration, change management, training, and stand-up of ongoing support.
* Provide direct technical support for owned solutions across the global manufacturing network — triaging issues, performing root cause analysis, delivering fixes, and managing the change and release process to keep solutions reliable and validated.
* Drive continuous enhancement of solutions in production, prioritizing improvements based on user feedback, operational data, evolving site needs, and emerging technology capabilities.
* Leverage AI tools and platforms — such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, and Anthropic's Claude — to accelerate solution development, automate routine engineering tasks, and embed AI capability into DME solutions. This includes building agent skills, prompts, retrieval-augmented patterns, and automated workflows on top of existing Lilly-approved AI platforms; it does not include training or developing foundation models.
* Evaluate emerging AI tools and patterns and integrate them responsibly into DME solutions, in alignment with Lilly's AI governance, data integrity, and validated-system requirements.
* Write, review, and maintain production-quality Python code that powers DME digital solutions; establish and uphold development standards, code review practices, and version control discipline.
* Build analytics, monitoring, and visualization capabilities using Seeq and Power BI to surface manufacturing insights to engineers, operators, and leadership.
* Partner with data leads within DME to define and provide the IT, OT, and ET data requirements needed to support each solution, and ensure data flows are reliable, governed, and fit-for-purpose.
* Ensure all solutions are designed, operated, and enhanced in accordance with validated-system, data-integrity, and GMP requirements, and develop and implement the associated technical requirements and documentation.
* Develop proof-of-concept solutions to explore new concepts within the Engineering Digital Strategy and progress them toward production-grade deployments.
* Ensure solutions focus on value generation and demonstrate measurable impact on manufacturing capacity, resilience, compliance, and operational excellence.

  

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Computer/Software Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering/science field.
* Minimum 3 years manufacturing experience.
* Demonstrated software development experience, with a strong working knowledge of Python.
* Knowledge of manufacturing datasets and experience accessing and using IT, OT, and ET data sources.
* Experience leveraging data to solve problems within a manufacturing environment.
* Experience working with validated systems.
* Experience in pharma or GMP industry.

  

**Additional Skills/Preferences**

* Hands-on experience building solutions in Seeq (advanced analytics, asset framework, monitoring) and Power BI (data modeling, DAX, dashboards).
* Experience acting as an owner or product owner for a production digital solution, including roadmap, backlog, technical support, and lifecycle ownership.
* Demonstrated experience providing ongoing technical support and continuous enhancement of digital solutions in a production environment.
* Experience leveraging AI tools and platforms (e.g., Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar) to accelerate development and to build agent skills, prompts, and automated workflows. Experience training or developing foundation models is not required.
* Familiarity with industrial data sources and protocols (e.g., Aveva PI, OPC UA, MQTT, historian/SCADA systems) and with enterprise data platforms (e.g., Databricks, SQL/relational data stores).
* Experience with one or more of the example solution domains: intralogistics monitoring, audit trail/data-integrity tooling, condition-based maintenance, equipment health monitoring, RCA/troubleshooting, equipment qualification, capital project workflows, or engineering knowledge management.
* Familiarity with modern software engineering practices: source control (Git/Azure DevOps), CI/CD, automated testing, and code review.
* Strong technical writing and communication skills; ability to translate between manufacturing engineers, IT/OT teams, and software developers.
* Ability to work well across different cultures and global manufacturing sites.

ec099e5a.title: Senior SAP Signavio Architect
ec099e5a.description:
**About the Role**

We are seeking a Senior SAP Signavio Architect to lead the migration of our process mining workloads from Celonis to SAP Signavio Process Intelligence. You will define the end-to-end architecture across Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Intercompany, and Procure to Pay, and rebuild full functional and KPI parity in SiGNAL.

This is a 3-month contract looking to start immediately.

**What You'll Do**

* Design the solution architecture and target object and event models for Finance and Procurement processes.
* Reverse-engineer Celonis data models, PQL queries, transformations, and dashboards, then rebuild them in SAP Signavio.
* Translate complex PQL scripts, macros, and windowing functions into optimized SiGNAL queries, resolving event sequencing, tie-breaker logic, and timestamp resolution.
* Partner with process owners and enterprise architects to classify assets as Migrate, Remain, Retire, or Archive.
* Direct data extraction and integration using the SAP Signavio On-Premise Extractor, SAP JCo, and RFC authorizations across S/4HANA, Ariba, and ServiceNow.
* Lead KPI parity testing and reconciliation against historical baselines, and support UAT sign-offs.
* Guide developers through architectural direction, best practices, and code reviews.

**Requirements**

* 8+ years of experience with SAP solutions, including 3+ years in SAP Signavio Process Intelligence.
* Expert-level Celonis skills, including PQL, data models, transformations, action flows, and dashboards.
* Proven ability to reverse-engineer Celonis configurations and rebuild them as SiGNAL logic.
* Deep knowledge of process mining methods: conformance checking, variant analysis, cycle time analysis, and root-cause analysis.
* Strong functional expertise in AP, AR, Intercompany, and P2P.
* Proficiency with S/4HANA tables (CDHDR, CDPOS, BKPF, BSEG, VBAK, VBAP), SAP JCo, RFC authorizations, and ETL pipelines.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.

**Preferred**

* SAP Signavio Process Intelligence or Celonis certification.
* Experience with SAP Build Process Automation, Ariba connectors, or ServiceNow integrations.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

Pay: ₹100,000.00 - ₹250,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in solution architecture, application architecture and cloud architecture, with Microsoft Azure preferred. The candidate should be capable of translating complex business requirements into secure, scalable, resilient and cost-effective solutions while guiding engineering teams through implementation.

**This is a Solution Architecture and Application Architecture role, not a Cloud Administration or Infrastructure Operations role.**

  

Key Responsibilities

* Own end-to-end solution architecture for enterprise applications and digital solutions.
* Translate business and functional requirements into scalable, secure and maintainable technical architectures.
* Design cloud-native applications using APIs, microservices, serverless computing, containers and event-driven architectures.
* Define application, cloud, integration, data, security and deployment architectures.
* Design enterprise integration solutions using REST APIs, API Management, messaging and asynchronous processing.
* Develop application modernisation strategies, including re-platforming, refactoring, re-architecting and SaaS replacement.
* Define and validate non-functional requirements covering performance, scalability, availability, security and recoverability.
* Embed security principles, identity management, encryption, API security and Zero Trust into solution designs.
* Provide architectural guidance on CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, deployment strategies and production readiness.
* Evaluate technology options, managed services, architecture trade-offs and cloud cost optimisation opportunities.
* Conduct architecture reviews, document technical decisions and establish reusable architecture patterns.
* Lead technical discovery workshops and engage with customers and senior stakeholders to understand business needs.
* Mentor architects, technical leads and developers, and guide engineering teams through complex technical challenges.
* Support the adoption of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI-enabled solutions where applicable.

  

Required Skills and Experience

* 8+ Years of overall relevant experience in solution architecture, cloud architecture, application architecture or similar senior technical roles.
* Strong experience in enterprise solution architecture and cloud-native application design.
* Strong understanding of Microsoft Azure architecture; AWS or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) experience is also valuable.
* Hands-on architectural knowledge of APIs, microservices, distributed systems and enterprise integration.
* Experience with application modernisation and designing scalable, resilient and secure systems.
* Strong understanding of databases, data persistence, application security and integration patterns.
* Knowledge of CI/CD, DevOps practices and Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience defining non-functional requirements and working across the software development lifecycle.
* Strong architecture documentation, modelling and technical design skills.
* Experience engaging directly with customers, senior stakeholders and engineering teams.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication and technical leadership skills.

  

Preferred Skills

* Microsoft Azure cloud-native application and integration services.
* Azure OpenAI and Azure AI services.
* Kubernetes, containers, serverless and event-driven architecture.
* API Management and enterprise integration platforms.
* Integration with Dynamics 365, SAP and/or ServiceNow.
* Generative AI, RAG and agentic AI architectures.
* FinOps and cloud cost optimisation.
* Architecture governance and Design Authority experience.
* AWS or GCP architecture experience.

  

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for an architect who can understand business problems, evaluate technology options, design complete solutions and guide engineering teams from architecture through implementation.

The ideal candidate should demonstrate strong architectural judgement, customer-facing consulting skills and the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  

**Important:** Candidates whose experience is primarily limited to Azure administration, cloud infrastructure operations or DevOps engineering, without strong solution and application architecture experience, may not be suitable for this role.

  

Why Join nxzen?

* Work on enterprise-scale digital transformation initiatives.
* Contribute to modern cloud-native application and integration solutions.
* Collaborate with experienced technical professionals and customer stakeholders.
* Participate in innovative technology initiatives across the Energy and Utilities sectors.

ecb0dded.location: Mumbai, Mumbai Suburban, Mumbai (All Areas), India
ecb0dded.description:
**Job Description: Data ArchitectRole Overview  
  

As a Senior Data Architect, you will be responsible for defining, driving, and executing the end-to-end data architecture and technical vision across complex enterprise solutions, projects, and transformation programs.

In this role, you will ensure organizational data is structured, integrated, governed, secured, and optimized to power business applications, advanced analytics, real-time reporting, and cutting-edge AI/ML systems. You will act as the key bridge between business stakeholders and technical execution teams—working closely with Solution Architects, Software Engineers, DevOps, Security, Analytics, and Business Leaders.

Key Responsibilities1. Enterprise Data Architecture & Strategy

* Design and execute end-to-end data architectures aligned with strategic business goals and complex solution requirements.
* Develop scalable data models (conceptual, logical, physical), data flows, schemas, and integration blueprints.
* Formulate robust data storage and persistence strategies across transactional (OLTP), analytical (OLAP), operational, and reporting workloads.
* Evaluate and select cloud-native, relational, NoSQL, distributed, and hybrid data platform technologies to ensure maximum performance, scalability, and maintainability.

2. Data Pipeline & Integration Engineering

* Design robust, fault-tolerant integration patterns—including RESTful APIs, ETL/ELT pipelines, event-driven architectures, real-time streaming, and batch processing.
* Define standards for data movement, transformation, synchronization, consistency, and dependency management.
* Architect seamless integration bridges connecting modern cloud platforms with legacy enterprise systems.

3. AI & Advanced Analytics Architecture

* Assess data readiness, quality, and structure to support enterprise AI/ML initiatives and advanced analytics.
* Build modern AI data foundation architectures incorporating vector databases, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, semantic search, and unstructured data ingestion patterns.
* Establish lineage, governance, and ethical safeguards around enterprise data used for training and running AI systems.

4. Governance, Security & Quality Management

* Establish technical controls, privacy policies, and data governance frameworks aligned with regulatory requirements.
* Define access controls, encryption, retention policies, and security mechanisms for sensitive and regulated data.
* Drive automated data quality validation frameworks ensuring data accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and end-to-end lineage tracking.

5. Technical Leadership & Execution Delivery

* Own the technical lifecycle of data solutions from early architecture through implementation and production deployment.
* Provide active technical oversight to engineering teams, conducting code and architecture reviews for data pipelines, queries, and integration solutions.
* Diagnose complex performance bottlenecks, resolve high-severity data issues, and optimize production query/workload efficiency.

6. Presales & Strategic Solutioning

* Partner with growth teams to deliver data architecture inputs for client RFPs, proposals, and solution blueprints.
* Conduct technical feasibility studies, data migration evaluations, sizing estimation, and risk assessments for new projects.
* Lead high-impact client workshops, technical presentations, and architecture alignment sessions.

Key Technical Competencies

* Data Modeling & Architecture: Conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling; Dimensional modeling; Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, and Data Lakehouses.
* Database & Cloud Platforms: Deep familiarity with modern cloud data platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, Snowflake, Databricks), Relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL), and NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB) systems.
* Integration & Streaming: ETL/ELT pipeline tools, event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ), streaming, and API management.
* AI & Next-Gen Patterns: Vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus, Qdrant), RAG data pipelines, LLM fine-tuning data pipelines, and semantic frameworks.
* Governance & Security: Data lineage, cataloging (e.g., Collibra, Alation), RBAC/ABAC security, and regulatory compliance (GDPR, HIPAA).
* Performance Optimization: Query tuning, data partition strategies, automated testing, and scalable data pipeline optimization.

Behavioral Skills & Core Mindset

* Strategic Business Alignment: Ability to bridge technical data architectures with tangible business outcomes and strategic priorities.
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Exceptional communication and collaboration skills to align engineering, security, analytics, and non-technical business stakeholders.
* Problem-Solving & Mentorship: Strong analytical capability to resolve ambiguous technical hurdles and guide engineering teams toward execution excellence.
* Technical Communication: Skill in simplifying and presenting complex data concepts to C-suite leaders and non-technical audiences.

Qualifications & Experience

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
* Experience: 10–15+ years of total experience in software/data engineering, with a strong focus on enterprise data architecture.
* Cloud & Modern Stack: Proven hands-on track record building enterprise data architectures on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake).
* Transformation Impact: Demonstrated success in leading enterprise data modernizations, analytics platform builds, or AI-ready data engineering initiatives preferred.**

ea76114a.title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
ea76114a.description:
**Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer**

We're looking for a Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to own the design, resilience, and day-to-day health of HealthEdge's infrastructure across AWS and our hybrid on-prem/Azure/GCP estate. This role sits at the intersection of cloud engineering and infrastructure engineering spanning AWS migration execution, disaster recovery, patching and platform currency, and the security/compliance controls that keep our security obligations intact. It's a hands-on senior IC role for someone who wants deep ownership of infrastructure resilience across a large, multi-account, multi-platform environment that's actively migrating off legacy on-prem infrastructure.

**Areas of Responsibility:**

**Infrastructure and Hybrid Cloud Architecture**

* Own infrastructure across the environments including secure configuration baselines and patch management for OS images and on-prem hardware
* Design, build, and maintain infrastructure across AWS (primary), with supporting work in Azure and GCP, plus the on-prem estate still in active retirement
* Build and maintain reusable, auditable Infrastructure as Code for cloud deployments, and for remaining on-prem server deployment.
* Support cloud networking execution, VPC provisioning, security group standards, and related connectivity work.
* Manage storage across cloud and legacy on-prem storage as workloads migrate; contribute to on-prem retirement and datacenter decommissioning efforts.
* Support AWS migration execution for in-flight waves, including server deployments and resource change requests via IaC.

**Disaster Recovery & Resilience**

* Own disaster recovery architecture and execution across cloud environments.
* Maintain DR solutions and backup strategy and run DR drills on a regular cadence; document gaps and drive remediation.
* Design for resilience from the start and treat recoverability as a first-class requirement, not an afterthought.

**Security, Compliance & Vulnerability Management**

* Contribute to vulnerability management triage across infrastructure teams, threat detection, and infra security findings review.
* Support PHI/PII classification scanning, penetration test coordination, and security exception approvals.
* Maintain compliance controls; support HIPAA and SOC 2 audit readiness, access review and recertification, evidence collection, and change freeze coordination.
* Maintain EKS container runtime security sensor coverage as part of ongoing platform hardening.

**Cloud Infrastructure Operations**

* Design and manage roles and cross-account access controls following least-privilege principles across multi-account, multi-cloud environments.
* Own cloud execution: load balancers, DNS (), VPC provisioning, and security group standards.
* Manage compute resources at scale with an eye toward right-sizing and long-term maintainability.
* Administer cloud storage and database services with attention to cost, performance, and resilience.
* Own infrastructure health, cost, and performance monitoring using native and third-party tooling, building the observability that lets issues surface before they become incidents.
* Administer and harden Linux and Windows Server environments across cloud and on-prem, including patching, performance tuning, troubleshooting, Active Directory integration, Group Policy, DNS, and certificate services.
* Manage hybrid identity and authentication across on-prem and cloud workloads, and maintain OS-level security baselines and hardening standards across the estate.

**CI/CD, Automation & Delivery**

* Build and evolve CI/CD pipelines for secure, repeatable infrastructure deployments.
* Write automation to reduce manual toil and enforce operational consistency across cloud and on-prem environments.
* Take solutions from proof-of-concept to production with an eye toward long-term maintainability, not just getting it working once.

**Reliability, Monitoring & Incident Response**

* Monitor, scale, and maintain production infrastructure with availability, performance, and security as top priorities.
* Participate in on-call rotation; serve as L2 escalation point for cross-team infrastructure support; lead root cause analysis and drive incident retrospectives to closure.
* Author and maintain runbooks that hold up under pressure, not just at handoff.

**Cost & Tagging Governance**

* Contribute to FinOps efforts: identify and remediate cost anomalies, own tagging remediation against enterprise tagging standards, and make pragmatic cost/performance/resilience tradeoffs.

**AI-Enabled Engineering**

* Use AI coding assistants to accelerate IaC development, scripting, and troubleshooting.
* Use AI tooling to draft first-pass runbooks, DR documentation, and incident retrospectives to validate and refine before publishing.

**Collaboration & Documentation**

* Document architecture, DR runbooks, and standard operating procedures others can actually follow under pressure.
* Provide technical guidance to product teams on infrastructure resilience, migration sequencing, and recovery design.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of hands-on cloud infrastructure engineering experience, with deep expertise in AWS and in other cloud environments.
* Direct experience with disaster recovery design and execution.
* Strong Infrastructure as Code experience (CDK, Terraform, or CloudFormation).
* Experience with containerized environments and Kubernetes/EKS, including version upgrade and lifecycle management.
* Linux and Windows Server administration experience, including patching and OS lifecycle management at scale.
* Solid IAM design experience, including cross-account access and least-privilege enforcement.
* Strong scripting ability (Python, Bash, or PowerShell).
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
* Comfortable being the primary on-call and L2 escalation point for infrastructure incidents.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience operating in regulated environments (FedRAMP, HIPAA, SOC 2) and understanding of what that means for infrastructure and DR design specifically.
* AWS certification (Solutions Architect or SysOps, Associate or Professional).
* Experience with hybrid infrastructure, bridging on-prem virtualization with cloud-native services during active migration.
* Familiarity with DISA STIG or CIS benchmark hardening, and vulnerability management/triage workflows.
* FinOps or cost governance experience, including tagging standards enforcement.
* Healthcare technology or digital health platform background.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering workflows as part of daily practice.

**Behaviors & Traits**

* Raises risk early rather than waiting for it to become an incident.
* Comfortable with ambiguity in a large, multi-account, evolving cloud environment.
* Strong sense of ownership; closes gaps rather than escalating and waiting.
* Communicates technical tradeoffs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.

 **Job Description**

As an Oracle Cloud ERP Functional Support Consultant (L2), you will be responsible for providing first and second line support across the Oracle ERP suite. You will act as the initial point of contact for user queries and system issues, ensuring effective triage, resolution where possible, and appropriate escalation to L2/L3 teams.

This is a process-driven, customer-focused role requiring strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to operate effectively within an ITIL-aligned support environment.

You must be willing to work flexible hours on rotation including cover until 23:00 UK Time/ 04:30 IST (shift allowance payable).

**Key Responsibilities**

You will deliver day-to-day operational support activities across one or more Oracle ERP modules (Financials, Procurement, Projects, HCM and other ERP areas), working as part of a global managed services team.

Your responsibilities will include triaging incoming incidents and service requests, assessing their priority and business impact, and ensuring they are correctly categorised, logged, and assigned within the ITSM tool. You will take ownership of tickets through their lifecycle, monitoring progress, proactively following up with resolver groups, and ensuring timely resolution within agreed SLAs.

As part of your role, you will resolve standard L1 & L2 queries directly. This includes responding to “how do I” questions from end users, providing guidance on system processes, and supporting users in navigating Oracle Cloud ERP functionality. You will perform routine system administration activities such as user setup, password resets, role provisioning, and basic access management in accordance with defined security and governance procedures.

You will engage with customers through agreed communication channels, providing regular and clear updates on ticket status and ensuring a high standard of customer service at all times.

Where issues cannot be resolved at L1 or L2, you will ensure they are escalated to L2/L3 support teams with sufficient detail, including replication steps, logs, and impact analysis, to enable efficient resolution.

You will contribute to knowledge management by documenting recurring issues, known errors, and standard operating procedures, helping to build a robust and reusable knowledge base.

Additionally, you will support service improvement initiatives by identifying recurring incidents or trends and raising these with senior team members to enable root cause analysis and problem management.

You will also assist in supporting Oracle Cloud quarterly release cycles by carrying out defined testing activities, logging defects, and supporting validation of fixes under guidance

 **Qualifications**

**Essential Qualifications & Experience**

* Experience working in an application support or service desk role (2 to 3 years preferred)
* Exposure to Oracle ERP Cloud (Financials including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, PPM and related modules)
* Good understanding of basic ERP processes and business workflows
* Experience using ITSM tools for incident and request management
* Familiarity with ITIL concepts such as incident management, service requests, and SLAs
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to work in a shift-based model and collaborate across global teams

**Desirable Skills**

* Hands-on experience with Oracle Cloud ERP modules (Finance, Projects, Procurement, etc.)
* Experience with user/security administration (role assignment, access control)
* Understanding of Oracle Cloud navigation, reporting tools (e.g. OTBI), or workflows
* Exposure to testing processes or release management activities
* Awareness of integrations or interfaces within ERP ecosystems

**Key Behaviours & Attributes**

* Customer-first mindset with a focus on responsiveness and service quality
* Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple tickets concurrently
* Process-driven approach with adherence to defined support procedures
* Willingness to learn and develop functional expertise across Oracle ERP modules
* Ability to work collaboratively within onshore/offshore delivery teams

  
**Additional Information**

**Why Version 1?**

At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
* Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance & Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
* Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance
* Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme
* Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
* Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
* Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards & ‘Call-Out’ platform.
* Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.

And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.

Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer.

We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, and we value the different perspectives people bring including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity.

8de87ed8.title: Cloud Operations Lead
8de87ed8.description:
We are seeking a **Cloud Operations Lead/ DevOps Engineer Lead** to join our infrastructure team. In this role, you will maintain, optimize, and scale our AWS cloud infrastructure while ensuring high availability and robust system performance. You will bridge the gap between core development and operational excellence by implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and participating in incident management cycles.

Unlike a traditional pure-play SRE role, this position focuses heavily on reliable cloud operations, infrastructure deployment, and proactive monitoring.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Cloud Infrastructure Management:** Maintain and optimize **AWS core services**, focusing on high-availability configurations, **Load Balancers (ALB/NLB)**, and multi-region networking.
* **Infrastructure as Code (IaC):** Write, maintain, and troubleshoot clean **Terraform** scripts to automate the provisioning of cloud environments.
* **Disaster Recovery (DR):** Design, test, and execute robust **DR strategies** and backup mechanisms to ensure business continuity.
* **Operational Monitoring & NOC:** Participate in Network Operations Center (NOC) activities, monitoring system health, and ensuring system alerts are actionable.
* **Incident Management:** Actively participate in incident response workflows, helping triage production issues, minimize downtime, and document post-incident reviews.
* **Technical Ownership:** Take ownership of operational tasks, driving them from identification to resolution with minimal supervision.

  

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field preferred.
* **Minimum 6+ years** of professional experience in Cloud Operations, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering, with a demonstrated trajectory of technical ownership and leadership.
* Strong understanding of Linux, Windows, networking fundamentals, and cloud infrastructure concepts.
* Familiarity with AWS, Kubernetes, monitoring platforms, and incident management processes.
* Experience with OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch
* **AWS Expertise:** Proven hands-on experience with core AWS services (EC2, VPC, S3, RDS, IAM) and a solid understanding of cloud networking architecture.
* **Practical IaC Experience:** Strong foundational knowledge of **Terraform** (modules, state management, and workspaces) to manage infrastructure safely.
* **Production Support & Troubleshooting:** Ability to dig deep into technical problems during outages, demonstrating strong root-cause analysis skills rather than just surface-level troubleshooting.
* **Operational Awareness:** Familiarity with basic **SRE principles** (SLAs, SLOs, error budgets) and modern monitoring setups (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus, or AWS CloudWatch).
* **Communication & Collaborative Drive:** Clear technical communication skills with the confidence to explain architectural choices and take accountability for production stability.

● Develop comprehensive and adaptable operational blueprints, safety manuals, and playbooks for decentralized technology assembly and maintenance.

● Ensure all R&D innovations are scalable, reliable, and replicable across diverse last-mile rural contexts spanning multiple states.

● Align R&D project delivery pathways with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (UNSDGs).

**2. In-House Battery Pack Production & Quality Control ("Bindi Shakti Battery")**

● Lead and optimize technical operations for the in-house battery pack assembly unit, standardizing production for five core configurations.

● Supervise quality standards, safety thresholds, and technical compliance across multiple cell chemistries:

○ NMC Configurations – 3.7V–7.8Ah cells for micro-lighting systems; 36V (7.8Ah/10Ah) battery

packs for light electric vehicles.

○ LFP Configurations – 12.8V (30Ah & 42Ah) battery packs optimized for Solar Home Systems and emergency power storage.

● Establish frameworks to prototype, test, and manufacture custom battery packs based on client specifications for E-Bicycles, E-Bikes, E-Scooters, and E-Rickshaws.

**3. E-Mobility Platform Integration & Optimization ("Sakthi Cycle")**

● Coordinate end-to-end engineering, Bill of Materials (BOM), and assembly workflows for the Sakthi Cycle e-mobility platform.

● Ensure component compatibility and performance integration across 250W BLDC hub motors, 36V smart controllers, 6-magnet Pedal Assist Sensors (PAS), and dual disc braking systems.

● Adapt high-tensile carbon steel chassis designs for rugged rural usage, optimizing heavy-duty cargo carriers, integrated lighting systems, and horn systems.

**4. Training, Capacity Building, and Field Deployment**

● Translate complex engineering specifications, wiring diagrams, and diagnostic manuals into accessible, visual training modules.

● Conduct continuous capacity-building workshops for rural women engineers to enhance their confidence and competence in electrical troubleshooting, field repairs, and hardware safety.

● Support field teams during regional pilot deployments to ensure successful implementation and long-term sustainability.

● Ensure all manufactured systems comply with relevant industrial certifications and standards, including IS 16045 and BIS requirements.

● Analyze field performance data to continuously refine and improve hardware engineering designs.

**6. Stakeholder Management & Documentation**

● Build and maintain strong collaborative relationships among internal execution teams, external component suppliers, B2B enterprise clients, and institutional partners.

● Maintain accurate technical records, assembly documentation, progress trackers, and case studies demonstrating technological impact on rural livelihood generation.

* Conversational proficiency in Hindi, in addition to strong English communication skills, for effective interaction with local assembly teams.

**Key Skills and Competencies**

* Hardware Prototyping and Battery Pack Manufacturing
* Lithium-based Battery Management Systems (BMS)
* Charging Logic and Circuit Diagnostics
* Battery Safety Systems
* Renewable Energy Systems and Electric Vehicle Development
* Cross-functional Stakeholder and Vendor Management

**Experience:**

**Qualifications:**

* Mobile applications, Web applications, API-driven systems, Ecommerce, ERP systems
* CI/CD, QA and release management, Technical Business Analysis, Software development or QA background

**What You'll Own**

You will be responsible for driving technology initiatives from requirement discussion through planning, execution, release, and stakeholder communication.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Work closely with the CTO on technology priorities, projects, and delivery planning.
* Convert discussions and requirements into clear project plans, milestones, tasks, dependencies, and deliverables.
* Coordinate developers, QA engineers, designers, product teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Own sprint planning, backlog management, task tracking, status visibility, and delivery follow-ups.
* Identify risks, blockers, dependencies, and missing decisions early.
* Ensure requirements are clear before they reach development.
* Help prepare and maintain BRDs, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional documentation.
* Break complex requirements into structured and actionable workstreams.
* Coordinate QA, UAT, release planning, and production rollouts.
* Maintain clear project documentation, decision logs, and release notes.
* Drive follow-ups and ensure action items are closed.
* Maintain visibility across multiple parallel projects and priorities.
* Own and continuously improve the project-management tools and workflows used by the technology team.
* Prepare project and technology status updates for leadership and other stakeholders.
* Present completed work, releases, progress, risks, and upcoming plans clearly to business stakeholders.

**Technical Thinking**

This role requires more than tracking tasks.

You should be able to understand modern software systems well enough to participate meaningfully in technical discussions.

You should be comfortable thinking about areas such as:

* Authentication and authorization
* Roles and permissions
* APIs and integrations
* Frontend and backend systems
* Databases
* Mobile applications
* Webhooks
* Background jobs
* Cloud infrastructure
* Environments
* CI/CD
* Logging and monitoring
* Security
* Data flows
* Failure handling
* Third-party integrations

You are not expected to be the architect or write production code, but you should be able to ask the right questions, identify gaps, understand dependencies, and challenge unclear requirements.

**AI-Assisted Working**

AI-assisted working is an important part of our engineering culture.

Our team actively uses tools such as
**Claude Code and Kiro**
, and we expect the TPM to use AI deeply across day-to-day work.

AI may be used for:

* Requirement analysis
* BRD and PRD preparation
* Identifying missing requirements
* User-story creation
* Acceptance criteria
* Task decomposition
* Technical research
* Understanding APIs and documentation
* Understanding unfamiliar codebases
* Summarizing architecture and system flows
* Risk identification
* Sprint planning
* Meeting summaries
* Decision tracking
* Release notes
* Stakeholder updates
* Presentations
* Project documentation
* Root-cause-analysis support

The candidate should be comfortable using AI to improve speed and quality while independently validating outputs and applying sound judgment.

Experience with Claude Code, Kiro, or similar AI-assisted engineering tools is an advantage.

**Project & Delivery Management**

You will own the operating rhythm of technology projects.

This includes:

* Project planning
* Sprint planning
* Backlog management
* Epics and user stories
* Prioritization
* Dependencies
* Blockers
* Risks
* Milestones
* Delivery timelines
* Release planning
* Project status
* Decision logs
* Documentation
* Follow-ups
* Cross-team coordination

You should ensure that the project-management system reflects the actual state of work, rather than becoming a passive task list.

**Prioritization & Decision Support**

You should be able to distinguish between tasks based on:

* Customer impact
* Business impact
* Technical risk
* Urgency
* Dependencies
* Security
* Delivery effort
* Release impact

You will work with the CTO and stakeholders to help teams focus on the right work at the right time.

**Stakeholder Communication**

Strong communication is a critical part of this role.

You should be able to communicate effectively with different audiences.

For engineering teams, you should be able to discuss technical dependencies, blockers, and implementation concerns.

For leadership and business teams, you should be able to communicate:

* What is being built
* Why it matters
* Current status
* What has been completed
* What is blocked
* Key risks
* Expected next steps

You should be comfortable preparing and delivering clear presentations and status updates to stakeholders.

**Who Will Do Well in This Role**

You will be a strong fit if you naturally ask:

* Is this requirement clear enough to develop?
* What decisions are still missing?
* What systems will this change affect?
* Are there security, permission, or data-flow implications?
* What are the dependencies?
* What could block this release?
* What should be prioritized first?
* How will QA validate this?
* What happens if something fails?
* Does everyone understand what is being delivered?
* Is the project status visible and accurate?

We are looking for someone who does more than track tasks.

We need someone who can think, structure, challenge, coordinate, communicate, and drive technology initiatives to completion.

**Why This Role**

You will work closely with the CTO and have visibility across multiple technology initiatives at Decode Age.

You will have the opportunity to influence how we plan, execute, communicate, and improve technology delivery across the organization.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of:

**Technology × Execution × Product Thinking × Communication × AI**

**About The Role**
We are seeking an accomplished and highly driven Senior Technical Program Manager to lead strategic Sales & Marketing programs in Rubrik IT. You will own planning and delivery of high-impact cross-functional programs that span Go-To-Market, Marketing automation, Web marketing, Sales Compensation, and Partner enablement. You will provide visible leadership, accountability, and governance across initiatives, from intake and prioritization through execution, go-live, and post-implementation optimization.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with a proven track record delivering complex technology programs, a deep understanding of Sales & Marketing processes, and exceptional collaboration skills to partner effectively with business stakeholders and technical teams.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
  
  

* Program Strategy & Governance

+ Lead one or more concurrent, complex programs involving one or more of these domains - CRM, CPQ, Marketing Automation, Web Marketing, Sales Performance Management, and Sales Commissions.

+ Partner with IT and business teams to translate business goals (Pipeline growth, Conversion, retention, Marketing efficiency, Partner performance) into clear program charters, success metrics, and implementation plans.
+ Establish program governance (cadence, forums, decision-making, risk and issue management) for Sales & Marketing IT initiatives.

+ Leverage AI into the overall SDLC in alignment with Rubrik’s Native AI expectations.

* Program Delivery & Execution

+ Create and own the program plan including cross-functional key deliverables. Negotiate and get cross functional alignment. Partner with Business and IT teams to align and commit on the program Scope, Schedule and Resources.
+ Own the full lifecycle: demand intake, scoping, solution approach, detailed planning, execution, testing / UAT, deployment, stabilization, and post-go-live optimization.
+ Build and manage integrated plans that cover business milestones, technical delivery, dependencies, data and reporting, and change management.
+ Track scope, timeline, budget, and quality, proactively identify risks and interdependencies and drive mitigations and trade-off decisions with stakeholders.

* Sales & Marketing Domain Leadership

+ Partner with Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, Product Operations, Channel/Partner teams, and Commissions to prioritize and deliver programs across:

- CRM (i.e. CPQ Cloud, Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing integrations)

+ Communicate program status, risks, decisions, and outcomes clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
+ Drive structured stakeholder engagement, including steering committees, executive readouts, business reviews, and change-management updates.
+ Partner with Procurement, Finance, and Legal to manage vendor relationships, SaaS licensing, and contracts across Sales & Marketing tools.
+ Track budgets and spend across programs, provide regular financial updates, including forecasts, variances, and cost-saving opportunities.
+ Ensure vendors and system integrators deliver to contracted scope, quality, and timelines.
+ Champion best practices in program management, GTM process design, and application lifecycle management for Sales & Marketing IT.
+ Identify and drive continuous improvement initiatives that reduce manual work, improve data quality, and enhance user experience.
+ Mentor project managers, business analysts, and scrum masters, foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.

**Experience You’ll Need**

* 12+ years of progressive experience in IT program / project management, technology consulting, or enterprise applications, with at least 8 years leading Sales & Marketing or GTM-focused programs.
* Understanding of Sales & Marketing processes across lead lifecycle, opportunity management, forecasting, campaign management, sales performance management, commissions, and partner programs.
* Hands-on experience delivering complex programs on CRM and marketing platforms (e.g., Salesforce Sales Cloud / Service Cloud, Marketo, Adobe Experience Manager, or equivalent).
* Hands-on proficiency with generative AI platforms (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) to automate project documentation, accelerate decision-making, and streamline cross-functional workflows.
* Demonstrated ability to leverage LLMs and prompt engineering to synthesize complex program data, conduct rapid risk analysis, and produce executive-level reporting.
* Track record of integrating frontier AI tools into daily program management practices to enhance operational velocity, optimize stakeholder communication, and drive efficient problem-solving.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional, global teams and manage stakeholders at multiple levels, including senior business leaders.
* Proven track record establishing program governance, managing budgets, and driving projects to successful completion in fast-paced environments.
* Proficiency with Agile and hybrid delivery models, and with project / program management tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Smartsheet, or similar.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to define business cases, quantify ROI, and make data-driven decisions.

**Nice To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field. A Masters degree is a plus.
* Experience in high-growth technology companies working closely with global Sales, Marketing, and GTM Operations teams.
* Formal program / project management certifications (e.g., PMP, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2, SAFe, or equivalent).

**About the Role:**

Solutions Consultants at Razorpay are the linchpin of our enterprise sales team. You will be the technical and strategic partner to our sales team, bridging the gap between customer challenges and Razorpay's innovative payment solutions. This is not a traditional pre-sales role; it's a chance to be a change leader and a revenue catalyst. You'll be the voice of the customer to our product team, the expert in the room with our sales team, and the trusted advisor to some of the largest enterprises.

**What You'll Do :**

● Solve Big Problems: Work closely with our enterprise sales team to understand customer business goals, challenges, and technical pain points. You'll architect solutions that solve their most complex payment problems, leveraging our core products and custom capabilities. Hence in-depth understanding of all our products is required.

● Craft Strategic Narratives: Create and deliver compelling presentations, detailed solution documents, and business proposals. You'll translate complex technical concepts into clear, executive-level narratives that demonstrate Razorpay's unique value proposition and quantify our business value.

**What We're Looking For :**

● Problem Solver: Proven creative problem-solving ability with a track record of leading and delivering full-lifecycle projects. You can demonstrate how to turn complex challenges into clear, actionable solutions.

● Technical Practitioner: Hands-on experience with technology is a must. You should be comfortable with APIs, technical definitions, and stitching together solutions across different platforms and partner ecosystems.

This role is the first filter and the main pen in our bid process. You will read every incoming opportunity, tell us quickly whether it fits, and then turn our technical team's input into a clear, compliant and on-time submission. You will learn bid strategy from senior presales and architecture staff as you go. Key responsibilities Opportunity tracking and review • Monitor domestic and global tender sources daily: GeM, CPPP (eprocure.gov.in), state e-procurement portals, PSU and bank portals, and international sources such as UNGM, World Bank, ADB and private-sector RFP invitations. • Read EOIs, RFPs and RFQs end to end and prepare a 1–2 page bid summary: scope, eligibility, pre-qualification criteria, evaluation method (QCBS, L1, technical scoring), deadlines, EMD/bid security and key commercial terms. • Flag go/no-go risks early: turnover and experience thresholds, certifications (ISO, CMMI), OEM authorisations, local-presence clauses, penalties, liability caps and payment terms. • Maintain a bid calendar covering pre-bid meetings, query deadlines, corrigenda and submission dates. Tender drafting with the technical team • Build a compliance matrix that maps every requirement clause to a response, owner and supporting document. • Brief solution architects and delivery leads on what each section needs; collect their inputs and turn them into clear, consistent proposal text. PTC | Junior Presales Executive (Bids & Tenders) | Remote Page 1Pauls Techno Crafts Encompassing Technical Craftsmanship JOB DESCRIPTION • Draft standard sections, with review by senior presales staff: cover letters, company profile, understanding of scope, approach and methodology, project plan, team structure, staffing model, SLAs and assumptions. • Draft pre-bid queries and clarification requests, and track responses and corrigenda. • Coordinate with finance and legal on commercial bids, BOQ/price schedules, EMD, bank guarantees and declarations. Submission and compliance • Assemble the final bid package to the buyer's format: technical and commercial envelopes, annexures, formats, affidavits, power of attorney and signed forms. • Run final checks for completeness, page limits, formatting, version control and PTC brand standards. • Manage online submissions on e-procurement portals, including digital signature certificate (DSC) uploads and encryption steps. Knowledge base and reporting • Maintain a reusable content library: case studies, CVs, certificates, financial statements, client references and boilerplate answers. • Record win/loss outcomes, competitor pricing where published, and lessons learned after each bid. • Share a weekly pipeline update of opportunities reviewed, in progress, submitted and awarded. Required qualifications and skills • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT or Business Administration; an MBA is a plus. • 1–2 years in presales, bid management, tender support or proposal writing, ideally in IT services, consulting or system integration. • Basic understanding of the tender lifecycle: EOI, RFI, RFP, RFQ, pre-bid, corrigendum, technical and commercial evaluation, award. • Exposure to at least one e-procurement portal such as GeM or CPPP; we will train you on the rest. • Strong written English: able to turn technical notes into clear, structured and persuasive text. • Careful attention to detail; able to spot missing documents, eligibility gaps and conflicting clauses. • Good command of MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint, including styles, tables of contents, tracked changes and basic formulas. • Able to handle several bids with fixed deadlines and to follow up firmly with internal teams over video calls, chat and shared documents. • Basic understanding of IT services: software development, staffing models, cloud, data, security and managed services. Good to have • Exposure to international RFPs (Middle East, US, Europe or multilateral agencies) and their formats. •

Familiarity with GFR 2017, the Manual for Procurement of Consultancy & Other Services, and Make in India / MSE purchase preferences. • Exposure to QCBS and LCS evaluation models and to preparing technical scoring self-assessments. • Basic knowledge of commercial terms: EMD, performance bank guarantee, liquidated damages and payment milestones. • Proposal or bid management training, such as APMP Foundation. • Experience with proposal tools or a shared content library (SharePoint, Confluence or Google Drive). PTC | Junior Presales Executive (Bids & Tenders) | Remote Page 2Pauls Techno Crafts Encompassing Technical Craftsmanship How success is measured Measure JOB DESCRIPTION Target Bid summary turnaround after a new EOI/RFP/RFQ is published Within 2 working days Bids submitted on time 100% Bids rejected for missing documents or non-compliance Compliance matrix prepared for every bid pursued Content library Independent drafting Zero 100% Set up in 3 months; kept current after each bid Owns standard sections of a full bid within 6 months What we offer • Direct exposure to domestic and international bids across staffing, consulting and managed services. • Mentoring from senior presales staff and PTC's Architecture Centre of Excellence. • A clear growth path to Presales Executive and Bid Manager. •

  

Fully remote work and a competitive salary, based on experience. You will need a reliable laptop and internet connection.
